Hi everyone. I'm Stefan from Shelly and today I will show you how we fully automated this Airbnb apartment. Here we are in the master bedroom and we have installed the Shelly 2L relay to power two separate lights, all controlled from the either Shelly Wall Display X2 or the Shelly app.
Here in the second bedroom, we have installed the Shelly 1 relay for full smart control as well. Same simple setup.
Here, we have the Shelly door window sensor connected to the AC and linked to the terrace door. Once the door is opened, the AC turns off automatically, keeping your energy bills low and preserving your AC from damages.
Here on the ceiling, we have the Shelly smoke sensor. The smoke sensor is an essential part of each house. It can send you alerts when there is smoke in the property. Here we have the Shelly Flood. It's placed near the boiler and washing machine and instantly alert if there is a leak. Protecting your property before damage happens.
Here in the dining room, we have the Shelly motion sensor. Besides protecting presence, it lets you build smart scenes, like automatically turning off lights when no one's around. This is the Shelly Plug S, one of our flagship products. In this case, we're using it for the iron. And if it's ever left by mistake, you'll get an alert and you can switch it off from the Shelly app. The Blue TRV makes your heating smart. You can set schedules, control the temperature remotely, and save energy between guest stays.
Also, you can connect it to the Shelly motion sensor. This means that when there is no movement in the apartment, it can automatically switch off the heating. This way, you save up to 30% of your heating costs. Here in the corridor, we have the button tough one. Once the guest checks out, he's instructed just to press the button. This instantly notifies the property manager who can then send in the cleaning stuff to get place ready for the next guests.
That's it, guys. And don't forget, make yours Airbnb smart with Shelly.

title: This Cat's Story Will Make You Cry
transcription: Have you ever noticed how a cat can change your whole world just by curling up in your lap? I want to tell you a story about a little stray named Willow. She wasn't born into a loving home. Born under an old porch, shivering through cold nights, tiny mews barely heard over the rain. Willow's days were spent searching for scraps, darting away from heavy footsteps, wishing for a gentle hand. But the world can be tough for a small cat. One day, she was limping, her paw injured, hungry, and alone. That's when I first saw her, huddled behind a dumpster, eyes wide and scared, but with a glimmer, still hoping someone might help. I remember crouching down, softly calling to her, my heart pounding as she inched closer, cautious. Days of quiet visits, leaving food, just sitting nearby until Willow let me touch her. The first time she leaned into my hand, I felt her whole body sigh. I took her home, cleaned her wounds, and promised she'd never be alone again. But sometimes life isn't fair. Her injury was worse than I thought. The vet said she might not make it. I spent every night by her side, whispering that she was loved, that she mattered. For a while, she got better. She played, purring softly, curling up beside me as if she'd always belonged. One morning, I woke and Willow was gone. Quietly, in her sleep, she'd slipped away, finally safe, finally loved. I still miss her, but for a little while, she found her home. Sometimes that's all any of us need.

title: The Biggest Bear Ever
transcription: Imagine standing face-to-face with a bear so massive, it makes even grizzlies look small. Today, we're diving into the incredible story of the largest Kodiak bear ever recorded. Kodiak bears are among the biggest bears in the world, living on Kodiak Island in Alaska. They can weigh over 1,500 pounds, stand 10 feet tall on their hind legs, and dominate their environment. But one particular bear set a record that stunned biologists and hunters alike. The largest Kodiak bear in history was estimated to weigh nearly 2,500 pounds when standing at full size. To put that into perspective, that's heavier than a small car. The bear's paw prints alone were bigger than a human head. While polar bears often compete for the title of the largest bear species, the Kodiak holds its ground. This record-breaking giant stood taller than most NBA players when upright and could swipe with a paw strong enough to crush bones in seconds. But what is the secret of its large size? Scientists believe Kodiak bears grow so large thanks to their rich food supply. Salmon runs, berries, and even whale carcasses washed ashore provide endless calories that help these bears bulk up beyond imagination. So the next time you think of big predators, remember the Kodiak bear and do not think that the polar bear is the biggest, as it was the biggest in the past, but now it is the Kodiak era. title: Anti-China Protests in Seoul Spark Tensions as Government Warns of Strong Action
transcription:
In Seoul's Myeong-dong, a district crowded with foreign tourists, anti-China protests openly expressing hostility toward China have become serious. As damage to merchants and tourists grew, Prime Minister Kim Min-suk, following President Lee Jae-myung, also called for strong measures. Reporter Choi Ha-yon went on-site to show how serious it is.
People gathered on the street are tearing apart China's national flag, the Five-star Red Flag.
Chinese Communist Party out! Chinese Communist Party out!
Recently, some conservative groups have been holding blatant anti-China rallies in Seoul's Myeong-dong, a district popular with Chinese tourists. Alleging China meddled in a rigged vote, they protested by the Chinese embassy and are widening their reach. As the uproar grew, President Lee demanded action, and on the 12th, police blocked demonstrators from entering the streets of Myeong-dong.
Local merchants are trying to make a living by selling to tourists, but they completely wreck things like this.
However, that same night, MBN reporters found the group undeterred, walking around the outskirts of Myeong-dong holding placards with slogans such as China out. Eventually, yesterday, they moved their protest to Daerim station, an area dense with Chinese residents, where various scuffles and disturbances broke out.
Ladies and gentlemen, why are Chinese people electing our president?
Prime Minister Kim Min-suk instructed the police today to respond firmly if necessary, but yet another rally is being held. Merchants along with Chinese tourists we consulted articulated their notable dissatisfaction and anxiety. As they shout those harsh words, all the foreign tourists leave, and I can't do any business at all. We feel bad and scared about this protest.
Meanwhile, People Power Party lawmaker Kim Min-jong criticized the government's hard-line stance on the anti-China rallies, asking why there is silence when it comes to anti-U.S. protests. Choi Ha-yon, MBN News.

title: Safari Lion Documentary 🦁 | Wild African Lions Hunting & Family Life | Full Wildlife Documentary 4K
transcription: Safari Lion documentary. At the heart of Africa's wild plains lives one of the most iconic animals in the world, the lion. Known as the king of the Savannah, this majestic predator rules through power, intelligence, and cooperation. Today, we follow the life of the lion from the pride to the hunt and explore what it takes to survive in the wild. Lions are the only cats that live in large social groups called prides. A pride usually consists of related lionesses, their cubs, and a few dominant males. Life in the pride revolves around teamwork. The lionesses share responsibilities, nursing cubs, defending territory, and hunting for food. Play may look harmless, but for these cubs, it's essential training. Each leap and pounce prepares them for the skills they will need as adults. A male lion with a heavy mane patrolling. The males may not hunt as often, but their role is vital. Their massive size and powerful roar deter rivals. A lion's roar can travel up to five miles across the savannah, warning intruders to stay away. Lions are ambush predators. They hunt mainly at night when the cover of darkness gives them the advantage. The females coordinate silently, spreading out to cut off escape routes. Only one in four hunts succeeds. But when the pride works together, their chances improve dramatically. Tonight their patience is rewarded. A successful hunt means survival, not just for the hunters, but for the entire. Even kings face challengers. Hyenas, scavengers, and vultures constantly compete for a share of the lion's meal. A feeding frenzy can quickly turn violent. Strength and numbers often decide who eats and who goes hungry. Cubs are the most vulnerable members of the pride. Less than half survive their first two years. Predators, hunger, and even rival lions pose constant threats. Only under the care and protection of their mothers can they hope to reach adulthood. Life on the savannah is a delicate balance. Every day brings challenges, from hunger to rivalries. Yet through strength, unity, and resilience, lions endure. They remain symbols of courage and guardians of the wild plains. The roar of the lion is the heartbeat of Africa, a reminder that even in a land of constant struggle, the king of beasts still reigns.

title: Adele lands multi-million pound book deal for autobiography - with a new album and tour in the works
transcription: Adele has landed a multi-million pound deal to write her first ever autobiography. Now, Adele has been wanted for years by publishers to bring out a tome all about her rise to the top, all about her life, and she's always said no. But for the first time, we can reveal that Adele has been snared, the deal is on the table, and it's being done, that Adele is writing her first book. Born in 1988 in Tottenham in North London, Adele went to the Brit School where she cut her teeth before she was signed by XL Recordings in 2006. Now, since then, Adele has gone on to sell over 120 million albums worldwide. As well as that, she's scored 11 top 10 hits including three number ones, and is probably one of the biggest music superstars to ever come out of the UK. Insiders told the Sun that publishers have been desperate to sign Adele for years, but she's always refused the deals. She's never wanted to sit down and tell her story. But now in 2025, the time is right and Adele is ready to start working with a ghost writer to put her story out in her own words. As well as her rise to the top in music, it's likely the book will take in her upbringing and her personal life, hopefully including her engagement to sports agent Rich Paul. And the book isn't the only good news for fans. We've been told that there is talk about a possible new album and maybe a tour next year. Now, Adele hasn't been on a world tour since 2017. title: Chinese EVs challenge German giants at Europe's largest auto show in Munich
transcription:
It's one of the world's largest motor shows, drawing in hundreds of thousands of visitors, lured by the prospect of a glimpse at futuristic electric vehicles, but also at the more realistic options the major manufacturers are offering. And at this year's show, Chinese cars are hard to miss. 30 years ago, carmaker BYD did not even exist, but now its vehicles are on show like never before, and its message seems clear.
Our clear goals are to be perceived as a European brand. We now also manufacture in Europe, combined with a very broad product portfolio. We now have 11 vehicles in the lineup and we're very proud of that. We really cover 90% of the product segments in the German car market.
These are some of their latest offerings, a mixture of hybrid vehicles and fully electric ones. Using flash charging, BYD says EV drivers will be able to go from next to nothing to around 200 kilometers range in just a few minutes. But some of their European competitors are skeptical. 
Volkswagen still leads in terms of new car sales in Europe, despite the perception that some of its existing EVs have been unpopular. For this firm it seems, the automotive offerings on show here are the way ahead.
New competition coming in, so we will readjust with this and now with the electric vehicles we're bringing in, plus another seven new electric vehicles by '27. We have a fantastic lineup that can compete with any of these newcomers. That they will, that the Chinese competition will come to Europe was always clear, and we will face it.
But how does a brand that calls itself the people's car bring back those who've lost interest?
What they've realized is actually customers don't really want to buy futuristic electric cars that they don't know. They actually like the familiar stuff. So I think brands like Polo really resonates with people in terms of it's a nice small car. And that means that, you know, in the future we're going to get an ID Golf, an electric Golf and a Tiguan and all the all the Volkswagens that you sort of know are going to come back in electric form.
There's no doubt that electricity is driving the mindset of European manufacturers right now. It's a view the German Chancellor shares. He says he wants his country to shape the transformation of the automotive industry rather than lag behind it. because it's clear where the global challenge is coming from. Dominic Kane, Al Jazeera, Munich.

title: FIRST LOOK - iPhone 17 Pro Max Hands On Review!
transcription: We are only three days away from the Apple event, and today we received some surprising new information about the future iPhone from Apple. According to a leaked South Korean telecom spec sheet, which is an internal technical document provided to mobile network operators by smartphone makers such as Apple and Samsung before a phone's official debut. Almost everything regarding the iPhone 17 lineup is detailed here. Let's start with the size. The Pro models maintain the same display sizes. The iPhone 17 Pro will feature a 6.3-inch display, while the iPhone 17 Pro Max will have a gigantic 6.9-inch display. The iPhone 17 Air, Apple's latest thin iPhone, will have a 6.6-inch display, while the normal iPhone 17 will have a 6.3-inch screen. Importantly, all iPhones in this series will include a 120 Hz promotion display. The iPhone 17 Air will include a high-density battery, but Apple will also release a battery cover specifically intended for this model. It will not be included in the box, but you may buy it as an add-on from Apple. This is where things get very frightening. Both the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max feature a 48 megapixel telephoto camera with eight times optical zoom and 8K video recording capabilities. Yes, iPhones will support 8K video recording. While few TVs are already 8K capable, Apple is obviously pressing ahead with this major upgrade. The Pro variants will be the only ones to use the Apple A19 Pro chipset. iPhone 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max. Both of these will have 12 GB of RAM. The processor will not be present on the iPhone 17 Air. Due to the ultra-thin design, it will most likely use the standard A19 chipset. Another significant innovation is a vapor cooling chamber, which will be included in both the Pro and Pro Max variants to aid thermal management and performance. The battery sizes have also been given. The iPhone 17 Pro will use a 3,700 mAh battery, while the iPhone 17 Pro Max will have a massive 5,000 mAh battery. The iPhone 17 Air will have a lower 2,800 mAh battery, while the conventional iPhone 17's battery capacity will remain same from last year. The iPhone 17 Air will be available in three colors: light gold, sky blue, and light blue. The Pro models, as expected, will get two new colors, orange and deep blue. So with that been said, let me know your thoughts in the comment below. If you are new here, please subscribe. Peace out.

title: Event-based Vision Sensor (EVS) - Detecting Changes in Moving Subjects [Technology] | Sony Official
transcription: The human eye is designed to see change. The human optic nerve does not process everything that can be seen, yet is designed to perceive changes in brightness very effectively. It is based on how the optic nerve processes information, and it records only the change in brightness. A new type of machine eye that realizes rapid and large-scale information processing. That's Sony's EVS, Event-Based Vision Sensor. With an event-based vision sensor, how do we capture moving subjects? Let's take a look. With conventional frame-based sensors, all pixel information is recorded in each frame. On the other hand, an event-based vision sensor reacts to pixels with luminance change by the movement of the subject. recognizing the change as an event. Coordinates, time, and light and dark polarities are combined as its output data for the reacting pixel. As a result, compared to frame-based sensors, Sony's event-based vision sensor can achieve high speed and high temporal resolution. It enables advanced data analysis that cannot be achieved under frame-based systems. Let's look at the pixel that outputs the event with Sony's event-based vision sensor. Pixel unit that receives light and brightness change detection unit are connected via copper pads and directly stacked top to bottom. This is Sony's copper copper connection technology. That makes it possible to increase the aperture ratio without any loss. In the entire sensor surface, reduction of circuit area contributes to the low latency. If the size is the same as a conventional frame-based sensor, both high resolution and high sensitivity can be achieved. and also capturing the change according to the rate of change in brightness. The sensor captures the subject with high dynamic range from low to high illuminance. This is Sony's event-based vision sensor.

questions.question: What is the primary difference between a conventional frame-based sensor and Sony's Event-Based Vision Sensor as described in the audio?
questions.answer: A conventional frame-based sensor records all pixel information in every frame, while Sony's Event-Based Vision Sensor only records data from pixels that detect a change in brightness, which it processes as an 'event' consisting of coordinates, time, and polarity.

So, the first and probably the biggest improvement you can make comes down to your display. Having a modern TV or monitor that supports HDMI 2.1 and features like VRR or 120Hz refresh rates is a game changer. The standard cable that comes with the PS5 works perfectly fine for this, but if you're using a different cable, just make sure it's HDMI 2.1 at least. Next, head into your PS5 settings. Under Game Default presets, switch over to performance mode. Then, go to video output and make sure ALLM or Auto low latency mode is enabled. Set variable refresh rate to automatic and confirm that the 120 Hz option is turned on. Higher frame rates and refresh rates mean less input delay and a much smoother feel overall. Even these changes alone can significantly boost your PS5's performance assuming your display can handle it. Now, even if you don't have a newer HDMI 2.1 compatible screen, don't worry. Just setting your PS5 to performance mode and enabling game mode on your TV will still give you a noticeable improvement. Also, you want to double check that the resolution set on your PS5 actually matches your display's native resolution, as sometimes setting the resolution to automatic actually messes with the colors. And a quick tip that I've found to be really useful is if you're experiencing lag and stutters, and if your resolution is set to 4K in settings, you might want to try and lower it to 1440p or even 1080p. This actually makes your PS5 GPU use less power on the resolution and focus more on FPS. Now, another area where players notice issues is controller input delay. While the DualSense controller works great over wireless, you can switch the communication method to wired if you ever run into inconsistencies. Depending on the game, you can also lower your thumbstick dead zone sensitivity, which is a handy trick to reduce any lag you might feel. And speaking of input and controls, one thing that's made my setup even smoother is using the PS5's Echokey keyboard for Gamescup. It snaps right onto your controller and gives you a quick access to a full keyboard, making it so much easier to type messages, enter codes, or chat with friends without slowing down your gameplay. Honestly, it's a game changer for anyone that hates typing letter by letter with the PS5's controller. I'm going to leave the link down below if you want to check it out, but that's basically it. It really is that straightforward. Follow these steps carefully and your PS5 will be fully optimized. If you found this video useful, make sure to like the video, subscribe, and hit the bell so you don't miss future tips.

title: All-New 2025 Volkswagen | Full Review & First Look

For decades, the brand has been known for building reliable, stylish, and practical cars, but this year, they've gone all in on combining tradition with the future of driving. Safety is another area that has seen a massive upgrade. The 2025 Volkswagen models come loaded with smart technology like adaptive cruise control, lane centering, blind spot detection, and even predictive systems that anticipate dangers before they happen. It's almost like having a co-pilot who's always looking out for you, making every drive feel more secure. What really makes the 2025 Volkswagen stand out is how it balances everything, style, comfort, performance, and technology, without losing its identity. For drivers who want to step into the future without giving up the reliability and character Volkswagen has always been known for, this is a lineup that delivers. It's more than just transportation, it's about making every drive smarter, safer, and more enjoyable. So when you look at the 2025 Volkswagen, you're not just seeing another new car on the road. title: Can I Take a Self-Guided Tour of Harvard University? - Everything About Boston
transcription: Can I take a self-guided tour of Harvard University? Imagine walking through one of the most famous college campuses in the world, all at your own pace. If that sounds exciting, you might wonder if you can explore Harvard University on your own. The good news is yes, you can take a self-guided tour of Harvard. The campus and the nearby Cambridge area are very welcoming to visitors who want to see the sights without a group. You can plan your own route to visit key spots like Harvard Yard, the historic center of the university, and the John Harvard statue, which is a popular photo spot. You can also check out Widener Library, a stunning building filled with millions of books, and Memorial Hall, a grand structure built to honor Harvard students who served in wars. Harvard Square, the lively neighborhood around the campus, is full of shops, cafes, and street performers, making it a fun place to explore on your own. To make your self-guided tour easier, Harvard offers downloadable maps and GPS-enabled audio guides. These guides give you background stories and facts about each landmark, so you learn as you walk. Harvard University is located in Cambridge, just across the Charles River from Boston, so it's easy to reach by public transit. The best way to start your tour is by taking the Red Line subway, called the T, to the Harvard Square station. Once there, you can begin your walk at popular spots like Out of Town Newsstand or the Harvard Square MBTA station. The typical self-guided tour covers about 1.4 miles and takes around 2 hours. This gives you plenty of time to see everything without rushing. If you want to spend more time at certain sites, you can easily do so. While self-guided tours do not include a live guide, the maps and audio guides provide enough information to make your visit interesting and educational. Harvard also offers guided tours led by students, which give more detailed stories and insights. But if you prefer exploring on your own, the self-guided option is a flexible and popular choice. From the perspective of the city of Boston, Harvard is a nearby cultural and educational landmark. It's a quick trip across the river, making it perfect for residents and visitors who want to experience a historic university on their own schedule. So, yes, you absolutely can take a self-guided tour of Harvard University and enjoy discovering its history and beauty at your own pace.

title: Elon Musk – The Billionaire Who Wants to Live on Mars 🚀 | Official Trailer #trailer
transcription: Let's talk about a man who looks at our world and thinks, not enough. I'm talking about Elon Musk. As of today, August 29th, 2025, he is the wealthiest person on our planet with a fortune built on electric cars, solar panels, and of course, rockets. But Musk isn't just collecting billions of dollars to build bigger houses or own more companies. He has a much grander, some would say much stranger goal. He wants to die on Mars. Not from a crash landing, mind you, but of old age as a resident of a new human civilization on the red planet. This isn't just a casual wish. It is the central driving force behind his life's work and the ultimate destination for his vast fortune. Why Mars? Why pour hundreds of billions of dollars into a project that many see as pure science fiction? For Musk, the answer is simple and profound. Survival. He views humanity as living in a single fragile basket. Earth is that basket. A catastrophic event, a massive asteroid impact, a super volcano, or even a self-inflicted disaster like a global war, could wipe us out completely. To ensure the long-term survival of human consciousness and our species, he argues, we must become multi-planetary. It's a form of cosmic life insurance. He has even pointed to the eventual expansion of our own sun, which will one day make Earth uninhabitable, framing this mission with an almost biblical sense of urgency. This motivation goes beyond just a backup plan. There's a philosophical and perhaps even a political layer to his ambition. For years, Musk presented Mars as a new frontier, a blank slate where humanity could start over, free from the old problems of Earth. It was a vision of a libertarian paradise among the stars. However, recent reports, particularly from his old colleague, Peter Thiel, suggest a shift in his thinking. The fear that a woke AI or a sprawling Earth-based government could simply follow humanity to Mars, has apparently tempered his view of the red planet as a political escape hatch, complicating his once clear-cut futuristic narrative. This grand vision isn't just talk. Musk has dedicated his wealth, estimated at over 335 billion dollars earlier this year, to making this happen. He has repeatedly stated that the entire purpose of accumulating his fortune is to fund the colonization of Mars. This makes him a unique figure in the history of wealth. While other billionaires have focused on philanthropy here on Earth, Musk's philanthropic project is on a planetary scale. He is the modern equivalent of a Pharaoh building a pyramid, not as a tomb, but as a launch pad to a new world. His companies, SpaceX and Tesla, are the tools he is forging for this monumental task.

title: LA crews halt hillside fire threat
transcription: About a quarter acre of heavy brush burned uphill near the 2,100 block of North Sunset Plaza Drive, threatening several homes above the fire. The Los Angeles Fire Department dispatched roughly 80 personnel, supported by helicopters and hand crews. Aerial water drops significantly slowed the blaze's advance toward residences. Initial reports indicated a vehicle fire that spread into medium heavy brush toward a hillside home. Mutual aid air and ground units from LA County Fire also responded. By evening, crews had extinguished all active flames and stopped the fire's forward progress. Helicopters continued water drops between homes to cool hotspots, while hand crews worked uphill on steep terrain aiming for full containment. Ground crews prioritized structure defense for the at-risk houses. Authorities issued shelter in place orders for Genesis zones LFDO817, LFDO819 and LFDO911. No civilian injuries were reported. Separately that morning, a two-story house on the 10,300 block of North Christine Place in Chatsworth caught fire after flames were observed on the first floor and spreading toward the rear. About 37 firefighters initiated an immediate offensive. The blaze was reported knocked down by 11:39 a.m. with around 53 personnel handling suppression, overhaul and scene stabilization. All occupants were evacuated and accounted for. One firefighter suffered a minor burn and was treated at the scene. City departments collaborated on the incident. The Department of Water and Power handled utilities, transportation managed traffic disruptions and building and safety conducted structural assessments. Motorists were urged to seek alternate routes due to congestion. Officials credited rapid multi-agency response, aggressive firefighting and aerial support with preventing greater property loss and injuries. Crews remained on scene working hotspots and containment.

Although not mass-produced, the C1 has a loyal following who prioritize comfort over the classic scooter style. Two decades later, BMW succeeded with the CE04 and CE02, two electric scooters that proved eco-friendly mobility can still be stylish. Now, Vision CE brings the C1 legacy, but in a modern format with proven electric technology. The most striking feature of the Vision CE is the safety cell. A metal alloy tube frame with custom seats and seatbelts. This system is designed to provide protection like a small car cabin, so helmets are no longer mandatory. This approach could be a solution to two major obstacles for two-wheeled commuters, the hassle of wearing gear and feeling hot in warm weather. From a design perspective, the Vision CE appears long, low, and futuristic. The safety frame is lightweight and open, more like an architectural framework than a cage. The chosen colors are simple yet elegant. Matte white combined with black, with neon red accents that give a modern and technical feel. The exposed aluminum details add a sense of robustness, while the matte seats and fine lettering keep the look minimalist. Another interesting feature is the self-balancing technology, which keeps the scooter upright even when stopped. Practical at red lights, easy for beginners, and provides a greater sense of stability. Technically, the Vision CE is based on the BMW CE04, which has 42 horsepower and a range of up to 130 km. Indeed, adding a safety frame can increase weight and slightly reduce performance, but BMW emphasizes that this scooter is specifically designed for short-distance urban travel. Although it's still a concept, BMW is known for often bringing ideas from the Vision CE into production. If it's truly marketed, the production version will likely add an aerodynamic roof for weather protection while also reinforcing the helmet-free claim. This combination of safety, comfort, and efficiency has the potential to attract more city commuters, even those who were previously reluctant to ride motorcycles due to inconvenience or risk.

title: Former California state prison reopens as ICE detention center amid protests
transcription: After months of backlash and confusion from the public and local organizations, operations at a Kern County ICE detention prison have officially started. Eyewitness News reporter Jake Shriner joins us now with what we know about the facility. Jake? That's right, a new immigration detention facility in California City has started housing detainees. Earlier today, I received a statement from the company that operates the center to learn more about how it will be run. The people, united, will never be divided! Despite months of protest, a former state prison in California City has officially reopened as an ICE detention center and is now housing detainees. CoreCivic, the private company that owns the facility, is one of the largest prison operators in the United States. Ryan Gustin, a senior director with the company, confirmed the reopening with Eyewitness News saying in part, this is, quote, in response to an immediate need from the federal government for safe, humane, and appropriate housing and care for these individuals. CoreCivic also wants to reinforce that they do not enforce immigration laws, arrest individuals, or have any say in an individual's deportation or release. CoreCivic has a 25-year relationship with California City, originally opening as a federal detention center, then becoming a state prison before it closed in 2023 under Governor Newsom's initiative to eliminate privately owned prisons in the state. There's no word on how long CoreCivic's contract agreement with ICE will last. There's also been reports that this facility will be the largest ICE detention center in California. transcription: We are just a few days away from the next iPhone event, which is scheduled for September 9th. While there are many rumors, we do have some verifiable details about the iPhone 17 Pro variants. The first is the revival of aluminum. If you are currently utilizing an iPhone 15 or 16, this suggests you are using a titanium made iPhone. While titanium is extremely durable, it is much more expensive and heavier than aluminum. This year, Apple is reportedly returning to aluminum. They're doing this to save money, and using aluminum will make the iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max lighter. The iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max will also see an increase in battery life. For example, the Pro Max model will feature a 5,000 milliamp hour battery, putting it on level with Android competition. However, a larger battery implies more weight, which is why Apple is employing aluminum this year to make the iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max variants lighter and more comfortable to carry. While we don't know exactly how durable these new iPhones will be, only time will tell. The second item you should consider is the redesigned back design. For the first time in years, the iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max variants will feature a fresh back design. This means that a massive camera bar will be there on the back. And it's not just for looks. It'll also aid to accommodate the spanking new 48 megapixel periscope zoom camera. This zoom camera will allow Apple to challenge Samsung's dominance in the camera zoom industry. Official cases for these iPhones were also leaked, revealing the identical leak back design as the next iPhones. It is predicted that the camera will have up to 8x optical zoom. Once again, this will be optical rather than digital zoom. Thus the quality will be excellent even at 8x zoom. The third thing to bear in mind is the announcement of the iPhone 17 Air. While the pro models will remain unchanged from prior years, Apple is discontinuing the 17 plus model and instead introducing the iPhone 17 Air. This will be a significantly thinner smartphone, with the sole drawback being the battery life. The battery will be less than 3,000 milliamp hours. title: Where Was Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon Filmed? - China Cultural Expedition
transcription:
Where was Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon filmed?
Have you ever wondered where the breathtaking scenes of Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon were captured? This iconic film, directed by Ang Lee, is a beautiful representation of Chinese culture and cinema. It takes us back to early 19th-century imperial China, showcasing stunning landscapes and intricate artistry.
The film was primarily shot in China, utilizing a mix of natural beauty and elaborate sets. One of the most notable locations is the Huangshan region in Anhui province. This area is famous for its dramatic granite peaks and lush pine forests, creating a striking backdrop for many scenes. The unique scenery adds depth to the film, making it visually captivating.
Another key filming site is the Anji Bamboo Forest in Zhejiang province. This serene forest is known for its lush bamboo groves, providing a tranquil environment that perfectly complements the film's more peaceful moments. The beauty of this location truly enhances the film's aesthetic.
Beijing, the capital city of China, also played a role in the filming process. The urban landscape of Beijing contributed to the cultural aspects of the story, showcasing the blend of tradition and modernity in Chinese life.
Chengde, located in Hebei province, was another filming location. This city offers a mix of historical and natural settings, which helped to create the film's rich visual narrative. The combination of these diverse locations allowed the filmmakers to capture the essence of Chinese culture.
Additionally, Hengdian World Studios in Zhejiang province was utilized for creating elaborate sets. As the largest film studio in the world, it provided the facilities needed to recreate traditional Chinese architecture and settings. This studio played a vital role in bringing the film's story to life.
Together, these locations contributed to the film's success, highlighting China's rich cultural heritage and stunning natural beauty. Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon is not just a film. It is a celebration of Chinese arts and performing arts, making it a significant part of Chinese cinema history. Each location, from the majestic mountains to the serene bamboo forests, adds to the film's enchanting narrative, leaving a lasting impression on audiences worldwide.

title: Germany's Deutsche Bahn in deep trouble | Lars Halter Reports
transcription: When you think of Germany, you think of cars and the autobahn, the country's famed highway system. But in an effort to lower carbon emissions, Berlin wants more people to switch to rail for traveling. Except the German rail provider is in dire straits. Lars Holter is with Deutsche Welle and joins me from Berlin now. Lars, thank you for being with us. What can you tell us about the current situation? Thanks for having me. Indeed, the Deutsche Bahn, as the rail provider is called, is in deep trouble and has actually been in deep trouble for many years. The company's infamous for delays and disruptions, but right now, the biggest concern is that the company doesn't even have leadership. Technically, of course, there is a CEO in charge right now, but he's been fired a few days ago by the government. That is because Deutsche Bahn is not really a private company. It is set up pretty much like a regular company, but it's fully state-owned. So the new government, frustrated with how business is going at the Bahn, stepped in. They told the CEO that his time will be over, but only once they found a successor. The problem is, so far, no one has been found. Apparently, some top managers were asked, but politely declined the offer. And meanwhile, the lame duck CEO is likely not very motivated to lead any longer. Lars, so what are the options for future here? What's going to happen to the German railroad? Well, the company needs a strategy for the future, that's for sure. But maybe it also needs competition. In Italy, they had very similar problems a few years ago, but ever since the state-owned rail provider there got competition from a private company using the same tracks, of course, things did actually improve. Trains got more punctual, prices are down. So maybe that's an idea to copy. Of course, the German system still needs a lot of work on its infrastructure, but it also needs to change its perspective and keep a closer eye on customer's needs. And for that, actually, one analyst recently had another idea, a small change to the perks for any new CEO, and that would be that he should not get a chauffeured business car any longer. The idea was to make the CEO take his own trains every day for short and long distances, so that at least he can experience how bad things really are, and hoping that it will change his perspective and actually help improve things. Thank you, Lars. Lars Holter there reporting from DW Berlin.

title: What Is The Rio De Janeiro International Film Festival? - We Go To Festivals
transcription: What is the Rio de Janeiro International Film Festival? Have you ever wondered what makes the Rio de Janeiro International Film Festival so special? This festival, also known as Festival do Rio, is Brazil's largest film festival and one of the most significant events in Latin America. It started in 1999 when two earlier festivals merged to create a more streamlined event. The Rio Cine Festival, which began in 1984, and the Mostra Banco Nacional de Cinema, founded in 1988, combined to avoid scheduling conflicts and make the festival experience better for everyone. Festival do Rio takes place in the vibrant city of Rio de Janeiro. Each year, it showcases a diverse selection of films, typically featuring over 350 films from more than 60 countries. You can expect to see a wide range of genres, including feature films, documentaries, and short films. The atmosphere at the festival is warm and inviting, making it a great place to enjoy both international films and a broad spectrum of Latin American cinema. One of the standout sections of the festival is called Premiere Brasil. This part focuses specifically on Brazilian cinema and is quite competitive. It features a significant number of Brazilian films, including fiction, documentaries, and shorts. This section provides a fantastic platform for local filmmakers to present their work to both local and international audiences. Attendees often have the chance to meet filmmakers and actors, which adds to the festival's charm. The audience also gets to vote for the best films in various categories, while an official jury awards the festival's main prizes, including the coveted Redentor trophy. The festival is held across multiple cinemas in Rio de Janeiro, making it accessible to a broad audience. In addition to film screenings, Festival do Rio often includes debates, special sessions, and lectures. These events contribute to the cultural and audiovisual development of the city. The festival plays a vital role in strengthening Rio's position in the audiovisual sector and promoting Brazilian culture on both national and international stages. Overall, the Rio de Janeiro International Film Festival is a major cultural event that celebrates cinema, supports local filmmakers, and connects audiences with both global and regional film production. If you are a film enthusiast or just curious about cinema, this festival is definitely worth checking out.

title: Burning Man 2025: The Desert’s Greatest Festival of Fire & Freedom
transcription: Each year in late August, Nevada's Black Rock Desert transforms into a temporary city called Black Rock City. What began in 1986 as a small bonfire gathering on a San Francisco beach is now a global cultural phenomenon. Today, over 70,000 people arrive with tents, bicycles, and art, building a community from nothing but dust. Burning Man isn't just a festival. It's a community shaped by 10 guiding principles: radical inclusion, self-reliance, and self-expression among them. Participants wear futuristic costumes, glittering masks, and LED lights. Strangers become friends, and the desert becomes a place of freedom, creativity, and unity. The playa is a living art gallery. Giant wooden temples tower over the desert floor. Mechanical dragons breathe fire, and surreal neon structures glow against the night sky. Art cars, transformed into moving sculptures, carry dancers and lights through the dust. Everything here is created by participants, and nothing is left behind. From sunrise yoga and meditation to all-night raves, Burning Man pulses with sound and movement. DJs spin under laser beams, drummers pound in circles, and fire spinners light up the night. The energy is raw and electric, a celebration of music, creativity, and life itself in the middle of the desert. At the festival's peak, the Man, a towering wooden effigy, is set ablaze in front of tens of thousands. Flames rise, sparks scatter across the desert sky, and cheers echo through the playa. Another sacred fire consumes the temple, a space for reflection and remembrance. And then, just as quickly, Black Rock City disappears, leaving only dust, memories, and the spirit of Burning Man.

title: Rare 1933 Footage of the Last Tasmanian Tiger | Colourised by NFSA
transcription: Once upon a time, in the wild landscapes of Tasmania, lived the thylacine, also called the Tasmanian tiger for the dark stripes across its back. Despite its wolf-like face, the thylacine was actually a marsupial, carrying its young in a pouch, just like kangaroos. It was the largest carnivorous marsupial of modern times, a shy and nocturnal hunter that fed on small animals and birds. Unlike dogs or wolves, its jaw could open to an astonishing 80 degrees, giving it a fearsome bite. Sadly, European settlers saw the thylacine as a threat to sheep and livestock. By the late 1800s, there were even government bounties that encouraged hunting. Disease, habitat loss, and competition with dogs only made things worse. The last known thylacine lived in Beaumaris Zoo in Hobart. Filmed in 1933 by naturalist David Fleay, it died just three years later, in 1936. That moment marked the end of a species that had survived for thousands of years. Today, the thylacine remains a powerful symbol of extinction and a reminder of the importance of protecting endangered wildlife before it's too late.

title: Pixel Watch 4 Hands-On: Best Smartwatch to Beat in 2025?!
transcription: This is the new Pixel Watch 4. It's got a great new design with a 10% larger display and some great new AI features powered by Gemini. Let's take a deeper look. The Pixel Watch 4 has an all-new design with a dome screen that's 10% larger than before, and it's brightest display yet at 3,000 nits. The Pixel Watch 3 peaked at 2,000 nits, so this should be even better in sunlight while retaining the 1 nit minimum brightness, keeping it less distracting in darker environments. On top of that, we're getting new watch faces and an updated interface that will make it easier to see what's on your wrist at a glance, as well as a stronger speaker and haptic feedback when interacting with Gemini. With a high of 88 degrees Fahrenheit and mostly sunny skies, wear light, comfortable clothing. Inside, the Snapdragon W5 Gen 2 is not only 25% faster, but it's more efficient, making the most out of the 455 mAh battery. Google claims that the 41 mm model will last up to 30 hours on a single charge, while the 45 mm model can last up to 40 hours. With a new quick charge dock, you can also get 50% charge in just 15 minutes on both sizes. LTE versions will also be equipped with satellite emergency communications. So, if you're out of the range of a cell phone tower, you'll still be able to call for help. The watch will send a text and your coordinates to emergency responders. And what device these days wouldn't be complete without AI? With the Pixel Watch 4, Google is using Gemini to enable particular features, such as automatic activity recognition, personalized health coach, and fitness and sleep plans. You'll also be able to use AI for smarter, contextualized replies to messages. Even better, you don't have to say, hey Google to start speaking to the watch. Just raise to talk. What are some good summer activities in New York? Google has also improved sleep tracking to make it 18% more accurate, thanks to a new skin temperature sensor. When it comes to price and availability, the 41 mm model starts at 349 and the 45 mm version starts at 3.99. Add $100 to each if you want LTE, but you can get two years for free if you purchase from the Pixel store or Best Buy. Pre-orders start August 20th with availability set for October 9th. So the new Pixel Watch 4 has a great design that's a lot better than the predecessor, and it has better battery life, too, which I can't wait to try out. I'm also interested to check out all the new AI features. It should make it a lot more useful to people on the go. So are you going to be picking up a Pixel Watch 4? Let us know in the comments. And be sure to follow us on socials at Tom's Guide. I'm Mike Prospero, and catch you next time.

title: Apple’s Vision Pro Has Little to Watch
transcription: It's interesting because they have this hardware. Now it is expensive and heavy, right? But they don't have a ton of software for it. Is that the case? Yeah, that's right. And you know, taking a step back, we've never seen Apple launch a major new product category that they've spent nearly a decade and nearly 10 billion dollars developing, sort of flop like this, right? The Apple Watch was a little slow out the gate, but pretty quickly within a year or several months, it started to go mainstream. Uh the iPod quickly went mainstream, uh the iPhone ticked up pretty quickly, the iPad was a blockbuster out the gate. Uh so this is going slower than I think even Apple anticipated to some degree. The best feature on the headset to your point is the immersive video content, some of the stuff we're showing on the on the display right now. But it's very limited. They have a few series, they only have a few episodes for each of those. They've only released 27 pieces of immersive content in the last year and a half. and it's a conundrum. It's very expensive to make, but why invest all that money in it if the headset's not selling well. On the other hand, that's why people would buy the headset because of that immersive content. So they're a little stuck here. Well, I mean there's only um so many hours of entertainment I can get out of like a dinosaur or Bono, right? So, um, why don't they either make more content for this thing or put it on hold until they're really ready to sell a product we need or can use? Well, here's the thing. Let's say the Vision Pro line doesn't take off for another two years. In 2027, they're going to release a much lighter, completely revamped cheaper version. So if they put out a bunch of content now and pile up all the content now, by the time people actually start using the platform, right, in two, three years from now, all that content is going to be outdated. They're going to refresh the Vision Pro in the next several weeks here, right before the end of this year, with a faster processor and a new strap. That's going to make it faster, more capable for applications, probably improve immersive video content, improve 3D video. It's going to make it feel a bit lighter when you're wearing it on the head. So, a bit of a marginal improvement, but the real changes are still far out. But again, the end game here is augmented reality glasses. This is going to be table stakes for all the tech companies within the next three to five years. Google's working on this, Samsung's working on this, uh and Apple has been working on this for several years. You know, the original concept for a headset for Apple was glasses. But they're not going to release glasses until they can get some visual quality, right on par with the Vision Pro at the thin and lightness of a glasses form factor, that's still going to take quite a bit more time.

questions.question: What is the primary problem with Apple's new hardware product, as discussed by the speakers?
questions.answer: The main issue is that while Apple has created expensive and heavy hardware, there is a significant lack of software and immersive content available for it, which hinders its adoption.

questions.question: According to the second speaker, what is the "conundrum" Apple faces with this new headset?

title: Dr.AI: COMPUTEX 2025 Best Choice Award Winner – Full Feature Showcase
transcription: In a major milestone for AI-powered healthcare, Dr. AI has just won the 2025 Computex Best Choice Award in digital healthcare. Designed for healthcare professionals, Dr. AI revolutionizes clinical workflows from hospital check-ins to post-consult summaries, streamlining inpatient and outpatient care with real-time AI tools. At the heart of this innovation is MedPA Medical Pre-assessment, a physician avatar system that lets patients speak to an AI doctor before entering the consultation room. Their symptoms are instantly transcribed into SOAP notes and sent directly to the physician's workstation. In the consultation room, physicians no longer need to manually document notes. With real-time speech-to-text STT, Dr. AI's SOAP Quick Note captures conversations and instantly generates structured SOAP medical records, saving time and improving accuracy. Dr. AI is already in use across major hospitals, clinics, and health examination centers in Taiwan, with the integration underway to scale nationwide. Expansion is also progressing into Japan, Korea, Singapore, and the Middle East. As the winner of the Computex Digital Healthcare Award, Dr. Clarence Liao stated. Dr. AI is designed to reduce clinical burden, support borderless care, and innovate the global standard of AI in healthcare. At Computex, Dr. AI also unveiled its next leap, the Dr. AI Smart Ring, a wearable AI doctor offering health insights and consultations anytime, anywhere. And it doesn't stop there. With the launch of Vet AI, the platform is bringing medical-grade AI to 24/7 pet care. From hospital to home, and even your pet, Dr. AI is redefining the future of smart healthcare.

title: Introducing Opal
transcription: Today, I want to tell you about Opal. It's an experimental product exploring the future of building with AI models and prompts. We want to deliver a product that gives users more control and transparency over combining all the capabilities of Google models without having to code. Come build in the open with us and shape the future of this product. Let's see what it can do. There are two ways to get started. You can remix apps from our gallery or you can create your own apps from scratch by clicking create new. Let's chain together Google models in this example to do deep research on a topic, draft a blog post, and create a video to go with the post. Opal takes the logical description of your flow and creates an AI mini app. Let's check it out. Click start to run the app. Let's enter future is no code as the topic and tech freelance blogger as the use case context. While we wait for Opal to work its magic, let's look at how you can share and edit. To deploy and share, click on publish Opal and send the URL to a friend or colleague. To edit, let's dive behind the scenes. Opal converts your app description into a multi-step workflow with inputs, generation steps and output steps. You can click into a step to see the prompt or instructions and edit them directly. For ultimate control, users can build these multi-step workflows directly by adding steps from the toolbar. Heading back to the app view, Opal has generated our blog post and video. We want to see what you build with Opal and shape the future of building with AI models and prompts together. Join us on Discord and try it out.

One of the key sets used was the Court of Miracles, which provided the perfect backdrop for the film's chilling scenes. The production team took full advantage of the controlled studio environment to create the Gothic look that fans remember so well. They constructed detailed sets that included a village, a farm, and the interiors of the Talbot family estate. And like many modern films that often utilize various outdoor locations, the Wolfman relied heavily on Universal Studio resources. This approach was common for classic universal monster movies of that era. The use of sound stages and backlot areas allowed for precise control over lighting and mood, which contributed to the film's distinctive visual style. The atmosphere created in these studio settings has influenced countless werewolf films that followed. The careful attention to detail in the sets helped establish a sense of dread and suspense that is a hallmark of classic horror cinema. The production team knew exactly how to use the space to evoke feelings of fear and intrigue. The decision to film primarily on the back lot also allowed for a tighter production schedule. This meant that the filmmakers could focus on crafting the story without the complications that come with on location shoots. The result was a film that has stood the test of time and remains a favorite among horror enthusiasts. So, if you ever find yourself wondering where the Wolf Man was filmed, remember that it all took place at Universal Studios in California. The backlot and sound stages were essential in creating the haunting world that has captivated audiences for decades. This classic film is a must-see for anyone interested in the history of horror cinema.

With the rumored $50 bump, the Air could hit $949, but some insiders think it might push past $1,000 because of its slim premium design. Now, here's the part that stings a little. While Apple seems ready to raise prices, Samsung didn't do that with the Galaxy S25. Google also looks set to keep Pixel 10 pricing mostly the same. So, in a way, Apple's the odd one out here. title: How to Build an Airbnb WhatsApp Chatbot Without AI | No Official Whatsapp API Needed
transcription: Imagine your guests getting check-in details, check out times, Wi-Fi info, and answers to common questions automatically, 24/7. It saves you time, keeps your replies consistent, and gives your guests a smooth, professional experience, all without you lifting a finger. This is exactly what we're going to build together today, an Airbnb auto-reply WhatsApp chatbot using only WhatsBolt, no official WhatsApp API needed. Once we've linked our WhatsApp account, we can create our chatbot by selecting the WA chatbot option. Now, let's select the profile where we want to set up the chatbot and click on add item. I've created a document with all the keywords and their respective answers for our Airbnb chatbot, covering details like check-in, check-out, Wi-Fi, and more. We'll keep the status enabled. For not matching default response, choose yes. Then, set recipient type to individual, since we don't want this chatbot replying in group conversations. For type, it doesn't matter in this case because this will be our default response. Give your chatbot a name and a short description. Keywords aren't important in this step, so you can just type any keyword. For presence delay, set it to 3 seconds and enable show typing. This makes it feel like a real person is responding. Now, let's set the message a user will receive if their message doesn't match any keyword. In our case, this will act like an index message, listing all the keywords the user can send to interact with our chatbot. As you can see, our message includes all the keywords we want our chatbot to recognize and respond to. And with that, we've completed the first step of our chatbot. Just click submit and our default response is ready. Now, let's create a new item so we can start automating each keyword one by one. This message will handle check-in information. We'll set no match response to no and select individual as the recipient type. Then, we'll add the relevant keywords, in this case, check-in, along with the message the user will receive. Next, we'll add two more items, one for check out information and another for Wi-Fi information. For the Wi-Fi item, we'll also include the keyword internet so the chatbot can respond even if the user types that instead. Now, click the run button to activate the chatbot, and that's it. Our chatbot is now live and successfully sending automatic replies to our users.

title: How To Properly Present PowerPoint Slides In Microsoft Teams [2026 Guide]
transcription: In today's video, I'm going to show you how to present your PowerPoint slides in Microsoft Teams the right way. Whether you're gearing up for an important business meeting or prepping to teach an engaging online class, ensuring that your slides are ready and running without a hitch is essential. So, let's take a walk through this process step-by-step. First things first, let's kick things off by opening the Microsoft Teams application on your desktop or through your preferred web browser. If you find that you're not signed in yet, don't worry. Simply click on the sign in button and enter your credentials. Completing this will unlock all the tools we need to dive into today's task, especially the vital screen sharing feature. Once you've settled in and signed on, turn your attention to the upper part of your Teams window. Here you'll notice an icon that resembles a video camera. Give this icon a click to start setting up your meeting. Once you're in the setup, go ahead and click on start meeting. At this stage, you have the flexibility to either invite others to join you or simply start a solo meeting. Practicing a solo meeting can be incredibly beneficial. Hover your mouse over this area and you'll spot the share button. Give it a click. This button is where the magic truly happens as it opens up options that allow you to either share screen or share window. If you want the greatest degree of versatility while presenting, opt for the share screen choice. This option provides you with the freedom to seamlessly switch between your PowerPoint presentation and any other applications you might need during the meeting. And for those of you with multiple monitors, it's important to select the screen that contains your PowerPoint. Now, here's a pro tip. Before you take the sharing plunge, have your slides open and ready to go. This simple preparation step ensures you can dodge any awkward pauses and maintain a smooth presentation flow. And there you have it. You are now well equipped and ready to present your PowerPoint slides confidently in Microsoft Teams. title: Carrying the Weight of Teaching: How Educators Can Manage Stress & Find Balance
transcription: Do you ever feel like you are carrying the weight of the world on your shoulders? As a teacher, I often felt like I'm juggling a million different responsibilities all the while trying to keep my head above water. The physical weight of a job is real. From grading papers, to planning lessons, it can feel like an impossible task to stay on the top of everything. But it's not just the physical weight that gets to us. The emotional weight of teaching can be just as heavy. From managing classroom dynamics to supporting students mental health. It can feel like we are carrying the weight of our students' emotions on our shoulders. And then there's the weight of expectations from administrators, parents, and even ourselves. There's a constant pressure to perform, to achieve, and to meet standards. It can feel like we are being pulled in a million different directions, all the while trying to stay true to our values as teachers. But what if we could find a way to lighten the load? To prioritize our tasks, to delegate responsibilities, and to seek support from our colleagues. By taking care of ourselves, both physically and emotionally. We can build the resilience we need to carry the weight of our job. We can find joy in teaching again and make a meaningful difference in the lives of our students. Remember, you're not alone in carrying the weight of the world. Teachers, let's work together to find ways to lighten this load, prioritize our wellbeing, and thrive in our roles as teachers. So dear educators, take care and wishing you good times from Ask Meena teacher.

title: FIRST LOOK: iPhone 17 Pro Max Hands-On Review!
transcription: In the world of smartphones, there's slim, and then there's Apple slim. This year, the tech giant is reportedly preparing to unveil its thinnest iPhone ever, the iPhone 17 Air, a device so slender it could almost vanish into your pocket at just 5.5 mm thick. It's a bold statement in design, a featherweight champion in the palm of your hand. But here's the catch, making a phone this thin often comes with a price. And according to reliable leaks, Apple may be trimming more than just the edges. At the heart of the iPhone 17 Air lies a special version of Apple's latest A19 Pro chip, the same powerhouse expected in the Pro and Pro Max models. Almost. The difference? One less GPU core. That might seem small, and for everyday scrolling, streaming, or texting, you probably won't notice. But push it with 3D gaming or heavy video editing, and the performance gap could become clear. Then there's the heat factor. A thinner body means less space to dissipate heat, increasing the chance of thermal throttling, where your phone slows down to cool off during extended workloads. And of course, a slimmer frame means a smaller battery. Translation, bursts of power, but maybe not the all-day stamina many users demand. The compromises don't stop there. To keep the air ultra thin, Apple is rumored to strip it down to a single rear camera, skip the high refresh rate display, and possibly reduce speaker output to just one channel. It's a list of sacrifices that make the Pro models, or even rival Androids, look more versatile by comparison. And yet, there's an audience for this. People who value elegance over excess. For them, the iPhone 17 Air could be the ultimate expression of Apple's design philosophy, light, minimal, and effortlessly stylish. Still, the question remains, will consumers trade performance, battery life, and features for a sleeker silhouette? When it launches, the iPhone 17 Air won't just be another smartphone. It will be a statement, one that divides opinion between those who see it as the future of ultra thin technology, and those who believe substance should never bow to style. Finally, what are your thoughts about it? So without being said, let me know your thought in the comment below. And if you are new here, please subscribe. Peace out.

title: DJI Mini 5 Pro – Hands-On Images Reveal MAJOR Upgrades!
transcription: We just got our clearest look yet at DJI's next ultra light drone, and it's not just a refresh. New images from well-known leaker Jasper Ellens via Drone XL reveal design changes, hidden tricks borrowed from DJI's newest models and even the release window. If you thought the mini series had peaked, you might want to sit down for this. The leak front-facing shot instantly gives away a few big upgrades. Front and center, a redesigned gimbal housing a one-inch camera sensor. Between the two main lenses, LAR sensors, an addition that hints at smarter obstacle avoidance. Even the motors have been updated, darker in color, but more importantly, compatible with quick release propellers for faster swaps in the field. Flip it over and the changes keep coming. For the first time in a mini series drone, there's a power lead port, just like the Mavic and Air lines. But the real head turner, it's expected to carry a C0 classification, keeping it under the 249g threshold. That means fewer restrictions in most regions without sacrificing performance. One leak shows ducted propeller guards with low noise tips, a design that echoes the DJI flip. The difference? These guards are removable, giving pilots the flexibility to fly light or add protection depending on the environment. This is where the Mini 5 Pro might completely change how people use a travel drone. Leaks suggest a side mounted quick launch button that can send the drone airborne and start recording. No controller required. If that sounds familiar, it's because DJI has already experimented with it on the Neo and the flip, but this will be the first time it lands on a Mini Pro. According to Jasper Ellens, the Fly More Combo with the RC2 controller will land around $1,200. And while DJI hasn't officially confirmed it, insiders are pointing to a September release window. If these leaks hold true, the Mini 5 Pro could be DJI's most versatile sub 250G drone yet, bridging the gap between portability and pro-level shooting. I'll be covering every update as it drops. title: Here's Why Liverpool Want Giovanni Leoni|Successor of Van Dijk?|Leoni best clearanaces #liverpoolfc
transcription: Liverpool's center-back plan is taking shape, and the next name on the board is Giovanni Leoni. At just 18, the Parma defender burst onto the Serie A scene last season, earning an Italy U21 call-up and a reputation for ice-cold composure beyond his years. Now, as reports suggest Liverpool are weighing a move, Anfield could become the stage where Leoni levels up from prodigy to Premier League force. Leoni is a modern center-half, aggressive in duels, calm in build-up, and brave enough to split lines under pressure. He steps in front with timing rather than rashness, angles his body to show forwards into traffic, and when he wins it, his first pass is forward. Aerially, he competes, but his standout traits are anticipation and recovery pace, perfect for a high defensive line that lives on front foot pressing. Think, win it early, play it early. Why Liverpool, why now? The Reds want at least one center back before the September 1st deadline. Jarrell Quansa has departed, Joe Gomez is nursing an Achilles issue, and Ibrahima Konate is in the final 12 months of his deal. That left Virgil Van Dijk and Konate as the only senior options for the community shield. Depth is not a luxury. It's a necessity. Leone offers upside today and headroom for tomorrow. The market picture? Italian reports float a fee around 30 million euros plus bonuses. Inter have long been viewed as favorites. Christian Chivu, who coached Leone at Parma, now sits in the Inter hot seat. Yet indications are the player would be open to Liverpool if the Reds firm up interest. Parallel to Leoni, Liverpool remain keen on Crystal Palace captain Marc Guehi, himself in the final year of his contract. Guehi brings Premier League certainty. Leoni brings elite potential at a friendlier price point. Two targets, two timelines, both fit a smart rebuild. On the pitch under Arne Slot, imagine Leoni on the right of a back two or easing in as a rotational starter. In possession, he can step into midfield to create a plus one, feed the number six, or fire diagonals to the far side winger. Nothing is done yet. Inter are watching. Palace's stance on Guehi will move the chessboard. But if Liverpool choose the high ceiling route, Giovanni Leoni ticks the boxes. Technique, temperament, and tactical fit for a system built on brave defending and faster transitions. Young, fearless, and built for the press. If the Reds make the call, Anfield could be about to welcome its next defensive diamond. Welcome to Liverpool, Giovanni Leoni.

title: The To Do List Summit Recap - San Francisco
transcription: Hey, it's Kevin, and this is my recap of the To-Do list summit in San Francisco this past weekend. The To-Do list summit is a brand new founder event in San Francisco, hosted by experts who led communications, video, social, and events at Y Combinator and Andreessen Horowitz. I applied, got accepted, booked my flight, and landed in San Francisco Friday night. I explored the city, grabbed amazing Mexican food, and finally, took my first Waymo ride, which was super smooth, futuristic, not cheap, but it was worth it. Saturday kicked off at 8:30 a.m. in downtown San Francisco. It was an intense, all-day experience surrounded by world-class people, past and current YC founders, ambitious builders everywhere. They tried a crazy idea, giving each founder a time slot to record a one-minute video using professional equipment to explain what our startups do and how we solve problems. They recorded over 60 videos. May God bless the souls of the editors who have to put all of that together. One of the crazy things about San Francisco is that you can cross paths with people that you would never meet anywhere else in the world. In between talks, I ran into Gustav Alströmer, a YC group partner, and we spent five minutes going back and forth refining my one-liner for Twintivo, which was completely unexpected, but fun and super helpful. These are my top three takeaways from the summit. The first one is to be super intentional with content. Is it for customers? Is it for investors? Is it for hiring purposes? Each needs its own structure and they want to see something completely different. The second one is that in order to earn the first customers, the winning strategy is to provide value first and then earn the right to pitch the idea. And content is the most affordable and efficient way to provide that value first. And the third one is that consistency is key, but only if the content is consistently high quality. So, from now on, I am only posting what the kids call bangers. The event was flawless. Huge thanks to the awesome team that made the inaugural The To-Do List Summit happen. If you are an early stage founder, keep an eye on theplatformteam.com for future events. Thanks for watching and see you in the next video.

title: How To Tell If Your Steam Deck Is OLED – Model Check, Specs & Display Tips
transcription: Wondering if you have the OLED or LCD Steam deck? There are several key differences that make identification straightforward. The Steam deck OLED was released in November 2023 as a significant upgrade to the original LCD model from 2022. Let's examine the key physical differences that help identify which model you have. First, check the screen bezels. The OLED model has noticeably thinner bezels around the display compared to the LCD version. The OLED model is also slightly lighter, weighing 608 grams compared to the LCD's 638 grams, a 30 gram difference you can feel. OLED models come in standard black and limited edition translucent shells, while LCD models only come in black. Another easy check is the kickstand. OLED models feature an improved, wider kickstand for better stability. title: Malaysians set on fire in Bangkok
transcription: Two Malaysian tourists were critically injured after being set on fire by an unemployed man on Ratchadamri Road, Bangkok on Thursday night. The suspect, a former boxer, believed to have poured thinner on the pair while they were seated on the steps near a shopping center. The two tourists reportedly attempted to escape after being doused with the substance, but the suspect pursued them and subsequently set them on fire. Malaysian Embassy Chargé d'affaires Bong Yik Jui said 26-year-old Ong is in the ICU with serious but non-life-threatening second-degree burns to his upper body, while 27-year-old Gan, who sustained 36% second-degree burns, is stable and conscious. Bong said the embassy has informed the victims' families. The suspect has been identified as a 30-year-old from Sa Kaeo province, who allegedly acted out of frustration over being unemployed. He was caught by members of the public while trying to flee and is now in custody as police continue investigating the motive. Statements will be taken from the victims once they are stable.

title: iPhone Rings but Apple Watch Doesn’t? FIX It Now!
transcription: Hey, are you getting calls on your iPhone, but they're not showing up on your Apple Watch? In this video, I'll show you how to fix the issue where calls come to your iPhone, but not on your Apple Watch. Let's get started. Before doing anything else, make sure to connect your Apple Watch with your iPhone through Bluetooth. Make sure to turn off Do not disturb mode on your Apple Watch. And also, make sure to turn off airplane mode. If still you're facing the same issue, then follow these solutions. Solution one, change Apple Watch notification settings. Open up the settings app on your Apple Watch. Tap notifications. Scroll down. Make sure to enable notifications indicator. And then scroll down again. And again, make sure to enable show summary when locked as well. Solution two, turn on notification on iPhone. title: How Do Product Reviews Compare to Official Appliance Ratings? - Home Appliance Report
transcription: How do product reviews compare to official appliance ratings? Have you ever wondered how product reviews stack up against official appliance ratings? Let's break it down so you can make informed choices when shopping for home appliances. Official appliance ratings come from independent organizations or testing labs. These ratings are created using standardized methods to evaluate appliances. They focus on measurable factors like performance, energy efficiency, durability, and reliability. The testing is consistent across all products in a category, which allows for straightforward comparisons. You can expect detailed data from these ratings, and they are conducted without any influence from manufacturers. This means you receive unbiased and objective information. On the other hand, product reviews, especially those from users or customers, reflected individual experiences with appliances in real-world settings. These reviews can give you a glimpse into everyday use, customer satisfaction, and practical issues like ease of use and noise levels. However, the quality of user reviews can vary widely. Some may be subjective or influenced by personal expectations. You might find reviews that are overly positive or negative, which may not representing the typical experience. Professional review sites and consumer organizations often combine both methods. They conduct their own tests while also considering user feedback. By purchasing appliances as regular customers, they avoid any bias from manufacturers. This results in ratings that are both data-driven and reflective of actual usage. When it comes to home appliances, relying on official ratings helps you understand the technical performance and reliability of a product. Meanwhile, product reviews can highlight real-life advantages or issues that might not show up in lab tests. For instance, you might learn about customer service quality or how well an appliance fits into a typical household environment. So, how can you use this information when choosing home appliances? Start by looking at official ratings to narrow down your options based on objective performance and efficiency. After that, check out product reviews to learn about user experiences, common problems, and satisfaction levels. By combining both sources, you can make a more informed purchase decision that balances technical quality with everyday usability.
