title: Han River Bus Trial Run Gets Mixed Reviews: "Smooth Ride" vs "Hard to Access"
transcription: With official operations scheduled to begin in September, Seoul's Han River bus service offered its first trial experience to citizens today. It departs from Yeuido, passes through Ttukseom, and arrives at Jamsil. Here's Yun Jiwon with the story from the scene. A thrilled father with his daughter and a cheerful young couple with a stylish stroller excitedly board the boat. This moment marks the first time citizens board the Han River bus, 17 months after announcing the plan to create public transportation on the river. The Han River bus is now setting off. With 45 passengers on board, the Han River bus departed Yeouido dock, passed through Ttukseom, and reached Jamsil after an hour. Under each seat, you'll find a life jacket for safety, along with a light and whistle that can be used to signal for help. To start with, avoiding serious traffic jams and enjoying the river's stunning views made this choice quite satisfying at first. Unlike ground buses which stop frequently, this bus moves uninterruptedly on the Han River, which I appreciate. However, weather conditions were noted as a challenge. Although the air conditioning system is functioning well, the heat in the cabin seemed to linger stubbornly because of the crowded conditions. The difficulty in reaching the boat terminal was highlighted as a concern. Getting to the water bus isn't exactly easy for pregnant women. You have to take the subway, get off, and then go up and down stairs. The excessive noise levels, making conversation barely audible, were identified as an improvement area. This is Yun Jiwon reporting for MBN News.

title: Asked to condemn the phrase ‘globalize the intifada,’ Mamdani says mayors shouldn’t ‘police speech’
transcription: I want to ask you about an issue that has divided some New Yorkers in recent weeks. You were recently asked about the term globalize the Intifada, if it makes you uncomfortable. In that moment, you did not condemn the phrase. Now, just so folks understand, it's a phrase that many people hear as a call to violence against Jews. There's been a lot of attention on this issue. So, I want to give you an opportunity to respond here and now. Do you condemn that phrase, globalize the Intifada? That's not language that I use. The language that I use and the language that I will continue to use to lead this city is that which speaks clearly to my intent, which is an intent grounded in a belief in universal human rights. And ultimately, that's what is the foundation of so much of my politics, the belief that freedom and justice and safety are things that to have meaning have to be applied to all people. And that includes Israelis and Palestinians as well. But do you actually condemn it? I think that's the question and and the outstanding issue that that a number of people, both of the Jewish faith and beyond have. Do you condemn that phrase, globalize the Intifada, which a lot of people hear as a call to violence against Jews? I've heard from many Jewish New Yorkers who have shared their concerns with me, especially in light of the horrific attacks that we saw in Washington D.C. and in Boulder, uh in Boulder, Colorado about this moment of of anti-semitism in our country and in our city. And I've heard those fears and I've had those conversations and ultimately, they are part and parcel of why in my campaign I've put forward a commitment to increase funding for anti-hate crime programming by 800%. I don't believe that the role of the mayor is to police speech in the manner especially of that of Donald Trump who has put one New Yorker in jail who's just returned to his family, Mahmoud Khalil for that very supposed crime of speech. Ultimately, what I think I need to show is the ability to not only talk about something but to tackle it and to make clear that there's no room for anti-semitism in this city. We have to root out that bigotry and ultimately we do that through the actions and that is the mayor I will be, one that protects Jewish New Yorkers and lives up to that commitment through the work that I do. But very people quickly, for the people who care about the language and who feel really concerned by that phrase, why not just condemn it? My concern is to start to walk down the line of language and making clear what language I believe is permissible or impermissible takes me into a place similar to that of the president who is looking to do those very kinds of things, putting people in jail for writing an op-ed, putting them in jail for protesting. Ultimately, it's not language that I use. It's language I understand there are concerns about and what I will do is showcase my vision for this city through my words and my action. We thank you for watching and remember, stay updated on breaking news and top stories on the NBC News app or watch live on our YouTube channel.

title: Meta Quest 3S Xbox Edition: a leaked collaboration
transcription: Meta and Xbox are set to release the Meta Quest 3S Xbox edition, a leaked collaboration that mirrors the strategy seen with the Asus ROG Xbox Ally. This initiative highlights Xbox's ongoing effort to partner with various companies to introduce licensed products into new markets, specifically leveraging Meta's more affordable next-generation VR headsets. While official details are pending, this collaboration primarily features an exclusive design for the Meta Quest 3S. Purchasers will receive a bonus of three months of Game Pass Ultimate subscription, an Xbox wireless controller, and an elite strap, aiming to provide a complete gaming experience directly through the VR headset. The leaked image suggests a limited release for the Meta Quest 3S Xbox edition, with an anticipated launch as early as June 24th. This partnership comes shortly after Meta opened its operating system to third-party hardware manufacturers, with Asus also expected to produce ROG-branded VR headsets. This indicates Xbox's strategy to diversify its licensed product offerings beyond a single partner. This collaboration is a renewed attempt by Microsoft to integrate Meta quest users into the Xbox ecosystem, building on the late 2023 introduction of Xbox Cloud gaming to VR headsets. This allowed Game Pass Ultimate subscribers to stream 2D games on their Meta Quest devices, offering an experience of playing on large virtual screens, albeit limited to full HD, 1920 by 1080 pixels, at 60 FPS. The Meta Quest 3S Xbox edition aligns with Xbox's vision of enabling any device, regardless of its native power, to function as a console through cloud technology. The Meta Quest 3S Xbox edition retains the same hardware specifications as the standard Meta Quest 3S. It features RGB LCD panels with a resolution of 1920 by 1832 pixels per eye and a refresh rate configurable up to 120 hertz. The headset is powered by a Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 SOC with Adreno 740 graphics, 8 GB of RAM, and internal storage options of 128 GB or 256 GB. According to the leak, the Meta Quest 3S Xbox Edition with 128 GB storage will be more than the original model. This additional cost covers the exclusive design, elite strap, Xbox wireless controller, and the three-month Game Pass Ultimate subscription.

Joy-Con drift is also still a very legitimate concern and it seems like there may already be a few cases of drift being reported. Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom are much better to play after the upgrade with the improved frame rate being the best new feature by far. The free Super Mario Odyssey update does deliver in this regard with notably better visual fidelity. Playing the entire Cyberpunk 2077 experience on a handheld is a mind-blowing experience that really illustrates just how far we've come. When it comes to backwards compatible Switch 1 games, it's currently a bit of a mixed bag. title: NATO Summit Recap | Dawn News English
transcription: At the NATO Summit held in The Hague on June 25th, 2025, leaders from the 32-member alliance pledged a significant increase in defense spending and reaffirmed their commitment to mutual protection under Article 5 of the NATO treaty. The summit was brief and carefully orchestrated to accommodate US President Donald Trump. NATO leaders endorsed a new target of allocating 5% of GDP to defense spending by 2035, a sharp rise from the previous 2% goal. This decision addresses both Trump's demands and concerns over increasing threats from Russia following its 2022 invasion of Ukraine. The official statement reaffirmed NATO's ironclad commitment to Article 5, declaring that an attack on one member is an attack on all. Trump had previously caused alarm by saying there were numerous definitions of the clause, but at the summit, he reassured allies, stating, we're with them all the way. The new spending breakdown includes 3.5% of GDP for core defense, such as troops and weapons, and 1.5% for broader security needs like cybersecurity, infrastructure resilience, and protection of pipelines. NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte acknowledged the financial challenge for European nations and Canada but emphasized its necessity, citing the current international security climate. Rutte, the former Dutch Prime Minister, noted full backing from NATO members, though Spain insisted it could meet its obligations without hitting the 5% mark, a stance Rutte diplomatically accepted to keep the summit smooth. President Trump praised the deal, calling it a great victory for everybody, and highlighting that nations were finally aligning with his long-standing call for increased contributions. The summit was choreographed to maintain harmony, including shortening official proceedings and hosting Trump at the Royal Palace. Trump described the hosts, King Willem Alexander and Queen Maxima, as beautiful and spectacular and posted positively about the event on Truth Social. Belgium's Prime Minister Bart De Wever labeled the spending hike as historic, urging Europe to take greater responsibility for its security. Trump also met briefly with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, referring to him as a nice guy and claimed ongoing discussions with Russian President Vladimir Putin. However, NATO will steer clear of Kiev's membership bid for now, as Trump has rejected it. Despite differences, NATO leaders emphasized unity, with Rutte affirming that US commitment to Article 5 remains firm and unwavering.

title: Ubisoft Developers Conference: 16 years of knowledge-sharing
transcription: At Ubisoft, we know how important collaboration is. That's why every year for the past 16 years, we bring together top developers from across our studios for a one-of-a-kind week-long knowledge sharing event in Montreal. The Ubisoft Developers Conference. It's a unique moment in our year where collaboration, learning, and growth take center stage and where we share the innovations that will define the future of gaming. During UDC, over 5,000 of our team members have the opportunity to showcase what they've been working on, from new tech to new production processes and creative game-changing solutions that push the limits of what's possible in video games. Teams also take time to test new tech in game demos, sparking new opportunities to share breakthroughs between projects and giving team members a chance to see what's coming next to the industry before everyone else. UDC is really a testament to the art, craft and expertise that goes into every world we create. The Ubisoft Developers Conference is also about mentorship with senior talent sharing their hands-on knowledge with newer teams, offering advice for games in production and career insights. This event is a platform where every voice matters and every idea has its place. Sometimes, all it takes is a new perspective to unlock a challenge. UDC celebrates not just our expertise, but our collective voice of creation, a moment to focus on what we can achieve together. And a reminder that at Ubisoft, everyone contributes to shaping the future of gaming.

The 32-member alliance emphasized their commitment to Article 5 of the Washington Treaty, that an attack on one is an attack on all, after Trump raised eyebrows by suggesting there were numerous definitions of the clause. However, he later reassured allies saying, "We are with them all the way." Trump celebrated the summit's outcome, calling it a great victory for everyone and a big success. He said countries would soon be equalized in terms of defense spending, which he has long advocated for. NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte acknowledged the difficulty for European countries and Canada in meeting the new target but insisted it was necessary given current global threats.

title: Retro Video Game Review - Metal Walker GBC
transcription: Back in the early 2000s, Capcom dropped Metal Walker onto the Game Boy Color and I gotta admit, I thought I had stumbled on some hidden mecha brawler gem. With a name like Metal Walker, you expect something gritty and full of robotic smackdowns, right? Well, you do get robots, but it's more like a Pokemon and a game of pool had a weird random baby. So here's the setup. You play as a kid looking for your dad on an island filled with relics from a mysterious metal called core. As you travel the island, you'll have a companion Metal Walker who's your little battle bot buddy that levels up and evolves based on core units. There are three types, land, marine, and sky. You can switch out orbs to give your bot new abilities. Some will let you smash rocks, one will let you cross water, and each one has different stats to tweak your strategy. Cool in theory, right? Now, the combat is where this game gets totally bonkers. It plays out on a top-down battlefield where instead of picking attacks from a menu, you'll launch your metal walker into enemies billiard style. You'll bounce off walls, collide with opponents, trigger environmental hazards, and hope RNG Jesus is on your side. Each round, a handful of random items spawn on the field, some helpful, some annoying, and by the way, enemies can pick them up too. So it can get chaotic pretty fast. Lining up a good shot is harder than you think, especially with the physics not quite behaving the way you would want it to. Add in the relentless encounter rate and you end up in constant fights that feel more like a chore than a challenge. I found myself wishing I could just turn it down a notch just so I can explore for more than 10 seconds. Speaking of exploration, this isn't a game where you can get lost. The NPCs give clear instructions on how to progress and the descriptions of places are pretty spot on. There's a neat mechanic where you can analyze enemies mid-battle to get new parts, which is probably the closest thing this game has to catching Pokémon. I ended up using a GameFAQs guide because some of the fights were getting too punishing without a bit of extra help. And trust me, the guide made a big difference. There are cheats available if you have a Game Genie or Game Shark. I didn't use any because I really do enjoy leveling up. Visually, Metal Walker is clean for a Game Boy Color title. The sprites are pretty sharp, and it all fits the sci-fi theme. The music was surprisingly great with a large soundtrack you won't get bored with. After all this praise, is it worth it? Honestly, no. The battle system is unique enough to keep me intrigued, but it's not the mecha brawler I expected. So, unless you're a collector or just dying for a fresh take on RPGs, you're better off watching a video or just reading about it.

transcription: How to fix your Joy-Con controllers not connecting to your Nintendo Switch too. So whether you're having pairing issues, connection issues or just charging issues in general, then I'm going to show you how we can go and fix all of these issues. Now, the very first thing we need to do is just go and disconnect our Joy-Con controllers from our switch. So I'm going to use the release lock at the back of the switch like so, and I'm just going to remove each of these individually. Now, once you've removed the Joy-Con controllers, just come around to the top of the controller and you'll see this small button here, and we just need to go and press this to turn off the controller. We're also going to do the same for the second controller as well. So once again, this small circular button, just go ahead and press this and the LED light should turn off indicating that the controller is now shut down. So once you've done that, we're going to come over to our Nintendo Switch, click on system settings from this bottom navigation, scroll all the way down on the left-hand side and select system, and then just press system update. Now, if there's any updates available for your Switch, you'll need to go and install these now. And once you've done that, we're going to perform a quick power cycle. Now, to do this, you need to hold down the power button located on the top of the switch and you need to hold this button down for around about 20 seconds. So you'll see all of the power options appear on the screen. Just go and ignore this and keep holding the button down until the screen eventually turns black. Once the screen's turned black, you can go and release that power button, and then you can just quickly press the power button once more to go and turn the switch back on. Now once the switch is back on, we need to go and reconnect our controllers to the side of the switch. Make sure obviously the blue controller is going to the blue side and the orange controller is going to the orange side. Now, once you've done that, go and load up your switch and we need to come back over to system settings. We're then going to scroll down in this left-hand navigation and select controllers and accessories. Now scroll down to update controllers and click on this, and you'll just need to give that a few seconds while it goes and updates your JoyCon controllers. After a couple of seconds, it will say update complete, and you can then close out of this window. Now, if it's still not working, the final solution is just to come back over to your home screen. We can then click on the Joy-Con controller icon at the bottom of this window. click on change grip/ order. and then once again, we're going to remove the Joy-Con controllers from the Nintendo Switch. You may have to click back on change grip/ order. And what you can do from here is once again, hold down the sync button on both of the controllers. So you can either do this at the same time or you can do each one individually. And if the controller is working, it should indicate a green LED light on that particular controller. Once both of the controllers display this green light, you can reattach them to the Switch, and that should have solved any connecting issues. transcription: So if you are still waiting for the Galaxy S25 FE, here is some good news. The first look at the phone is finally out. Some rumor says the screen might get really bright up to 2600 nits, but that's not confirmed yet. title: The mighty ocean
transcription: Have you ever wondered what secrets lie deep beneath the ocean's surface? Close your eyes and dive in with me. Splash. You're now swimming in the deep blue sea. But wait, what's that? A shadow is moving fast. It's a dolphin and it wants to race. You try to keep up, but dolphins are the ocean's speed champions. They click, whistle, and laugh, as if they're cheering you on. As you dive deeper, the water gets darker. Something glides past. It's a sea turtle, slow and graceful. She's been swimming for 50 years, and now she's returning to the beach where she was born. Just to lay her eggs. She nods at you, like she remembers something from long ago. Suddenly, the water changes color. Not because of the sun, but because of an octopus. It squirts ink and disappears into the rocks. Wait, did it just change color to match the coral? And did it just open a jar with its arms? That's one smart sea creature. You keep swimming, and then you feel it. A strange, soft glow all around you. Jellyfish. Dozens of them, glowing in the dark like underwater stars. They float gently, silently. Beautiful, but mysterious. Then just when you think nothing could be more magical, you hear a low, distant sound, like a drum beat. Boom. Boom. Boom. A giant shape approaches. It's the blue whale, the biggest animal to ever live. Bigger than any dinosaur. And its heart? The size of a car. You float beside it, feeling very small, but not afraid. Because here in the ocean, everything has its place. And now, you're a part of it too. The ocean is waiting for you. Full of stories, full of wonders. Will you return?

title: Samsung Galaxy S25 FE – First Look is HERE!
transcription: So those who are waiting for the S25 FE, your first look is finally here. And it's coming from none other than trusted leaker OnLeaks. At first glance, the design might seem unchanged, but there are three key differences compared to the S24 FE. First, the device is noticeably thinner. Reports says it's just 7.4 mm thick, down from 8 mm on the previous model. Second, the bezels are getting slimmer, giving you more screen and a more modern look. And third, the camera design now matches the Galaxy S25 Edge, making the S25 FE look far more premium this time around. So, S25 FE is expected to retain the same 6.7 inch 120 Hz display, but this time it's switching from Dynamic AMOLED to Super AMOLED. That means we're likely looking at up to 2600 nits of peak brightness, making it far more usable in direct sunlight. Now, under the hood, it's almost confirmed that Samsung will go with the Exynos 2400, not the newer 2500, reportedly due to production constraints. Performance on the S24 FE wasn't bad, but the battery life did fall short of the regular S24, even with a bigger battery. That's mainly because it used a tone-down version of the Exynos 2400. So, with the full Exynos 2400 this time, we should see a noticeably boost in battery performance. Finally, closing the gap with the flagship S series. We've also got a selfie camera upgrade, going from 10 megapixel to 12 megapixel, which should improve detail and clarity. Plus, you're getting seven years of OS and security updates. The phone is launching with Android 16 out of the box, which means it could receive updates all the way up to Android 23. Storage wise, the S24 FE already had UFS 3.1 for the 128 gigs model and UFS 4.0 for 256 gigs. That's fast and the S25 FE is expected to continue that trend. Recently Apple announced iOS 26 bringing some major changes. iOS 26 is packed with intelligent experiences, meaningful improvements to the things you do every day, and a new design where we've also refreshed a number of system experiences and apps. However, the Galaxy S25 FE is also coming with One UI 8 straight out of the box. One UI 8 will also bring some major upgrades as well. While the One UI 8 beta is already out, the official release is along with the Z Fold 7 launch. So, S25 FE is expected to launch around October, so there's still time for more solid leaks and confirmation to come true. So yeah, if you're looking for a well-balanced phone with long-term software support and that signature Samsung polish, the S25 FE will be a smart pick. Stay tuned for more updates and don't forget to subscribe. Peace out.

With its bold angular design and stainless steel exoskeleton, the Cybertruck looks like it's been dropped straight out of a sci-fi movie. Tesla now offers optional wrap colors including matte black, stealth gray and satin white for those who want a more refined or personalized look. The front of the Cybertruck is defined by its continuous sled light bar and flat nose with no traditional grill. The armored glass windows are carried over from earlier prototypes, now upgraded for even more durability. The sharp edges and geometric body panels are not just for show, they also contribute to the vehicle's rigidity and aerodynamics. With its high ground clearance and massive wheels, the Cybertruck still dominates visually on and off the road. Inside the 2026 Cybertruck, you get a minimalist cabin with a large central touchscreen and a yoke style steering wheel. The interior seats six with a fold down front center console and features sustainable materials throughout. The Cybertruck offers multiple power drain options with dual and tri motor setups delivering up to 800 horsepower and over 500 miles of range. It can tow up to 14,000 lbs and accelerate from 0 to 60 in under 2.9 seconds. Pricing starts at around $60,000 and can go beyond 90,000 depending on the configuration. title: Dua Lipa on Pedro Almodóvar
transcription: My favorite director, Pedro Almodova. Hola Pedro, como estas? I feel like you're very meticulous in your detail and you bring certain parts of your life into your stories. There's always moments when I, you know, read stories or I watch videos or I watch movies and I go, wow, I wish I lived through that time and that experience when there was so much energy and creativity. I think that's the beauty of it is the kind of punk rock element. As long as you get the story across, as long as you get your message and your point, then that's also the the beauty of the artistry. The first era of your career, as you've called it, was like a response to the end of the Franco regime. You know, I imagine that anybody under the fringes of an authoritarian regime, once they feel like they've been freed, then in a way you can kind of create what you want, be how you want. One of the things that I and many many audiences love about you is the way that you tell stories about women and about queer people going as far back as your first film to tell those sorts of stories when they might have been considered countercultural. I think what I really see is a presentation of a more normalized world is what it or at least what we want a normalized world to be. and the way that it's presented I think is is amazing because the characters never feel like they have to prove something. They just are unapologetically themselves. They arrive fully formed and I think that's really inspiring. And and about the women too, I I feel a deep connection to all of that and the and the stories and you know, you listening to women and seeing how they express themselves. It's very fascinating to me. you know, your movies deal with so many themes, you know, love, sex, politics, family, faith, art. Because I've watched so many of them, I feel like they have many similarities and they all share such common DNA, but I think every single one is quite different, you know, from the last.

title: What Is The Adidas Firebird Tracksuit? - Hip Hop Gurus
transcription: What is the Adidas Firebird tracksuit? Have you ever wondered how a simple tracksuit became a cultural icon in hip-hop fashion? The Adidas Firebird tracksuit is a perfect example of this phenomenon. Originally launched in the 1980s, this tracksuit features the iconic three stripes along the sleeves and pant legs. It evolved from earlier Adidas styles, such as the Beckenbauer tracksuit, and quickly became a symbol of athletic excellence and street style. The Firebird tracksuit typically consists of a zip-up jacket and matching pants made from shiny polyester fabric. This sleek and sporty look made it a favorite among athletes and fashion enthusiasts alike. In hip-hop culture, the Firebird tracksuit holds a special place as a cultural emblem. During the 1980s, it became closely associated with the emerging hip-hop scene, especially among B-boys, MCS, and break dancers. The tracksuit was embraced for its comfort and durability, which suited the dynamic movements of breakdancing and the expressive fashion of hip-hop artists. One of the most significant moments linking the Adidas Firebird tracksuit to hip-hop came from the legendary rap group Run-DMC from Queens, New York. They famously wore the Firebird tracksuit as part of their signature look, pairing it with Adidas Superstar sneakers and gold chains. This image became iconic and helped establish the tracksuit as the unofficial uniform of old-school hip-hop. Run-DMC's 1986 hit, My Adidas, celebrated the brand and its connection to their identity. This song led to the first major endorsement deal between a music group and a sportswear company, marking a turning point in both music and fashion. The Firebird tracksuit's influence extended beyond just fashion. It symbolized authenticity, street credibility, and unity within the hip-hop community. It bridged the gap between sportswear and music culture, making Adidas a staple brand in hip-hop fashion. Even today, the Firebird tracksuit is revered as a retro classic that represents the roots of hip-hop style. It continues to be worn and celebrated by artists and fans alike. The Adidas Firebird tracksuit is more than just athletic wear. It is a cultural icon that helped define hip-hop fashion in the 1980s and remains a symbol of the genre's early style and attitude.

title: How To Share a Powerpoint Presentation in a Teams Meeting Microsoft [2025 Full Guide]
transcription: In today's video, I'm going to teach you how to seamlessly share a PowerPoint presentation in a Microsoft Teams meeting. Whether you're collaborating with colleagues or presenting to clients, sharing your slides smoothly can make a big difference in how your message is received. So, let's dive right in and make sure you're fully prepared for your next virtual presentation. To begin, you'll need to open PowerPoint on your computer. This might seem like a simple step, but it's crucial as it sets the foundation for everything that we'll do next. Once PowerPoint is up and running, go ahead and navigate to the specific presentation that you plan to share. Ensure that everything in your slides is ready to go with any final touches or edits already completed. Being fully prepared at this stage will make the sharing process much smoother. Next, look towards the top right corner of the PowerPoint window where you'll see a button labeled share. Clicking this button is the gateway to distributing your presentation, so make sure to locate it accurately. Once you've clicked on the share button, a menu of options will appear. What you need to do here is simply click on copy link. This option will generate a shareable link to your presentation, making it easy for others to access it directly. After selecting copy link, you'll be prompted to click the copy button. This step is vital as it places the link onto your clipboard, ready to be pasted wherever you need it. Now, with your link copied, you're ready to move on to the final step, sharing it with your teams. Open your Microsoft Teams application and choose the specific meeting or chat where you'd like to present your PowerPoint. You can paste the link directly into the chat with a friendly note, letting your teammates or audience know it's the presentation you'll be discussing. Alternatively, if you're in a meeting, you might paste it in the chat section for all the participants to easily access. This simple act ensures everyone in your session can follow along with your slides in real time. By following these straightforward steps, you'll be able to share your presentation effortlessly, allowing you to focus on delivering your content effectively. Remember, being familiar with the technical aspects of your virtual tools can greatly enhance your confidence and delivery during a presentation. So there you have it. title: Advantech at COMPUTEX 2025 | Unboxing MIC-743
transcription: Hello everyone. This is Elvis from Advantech. Welcome to our booth at Computex. Today, I'm excited to unveil a truly groundbreaking live demo, a pioneering solution powered by NVIDIA Jetson Thor. Jetson Thor delivers up to 2,074 FP4 TFLOPS of AI performance with 128 GB of memory, making it the ultimate platform of AI-enhanced robotics, edge-based LLM, VLLM, and autonomous machines. In this demo, we are showcasing video search and summarization, a task that previously required four to eight H100 GPUs in a server environment. Now, thanks to Advantech's MIC-744 and the 743 Jetson Thor systems, VSS can run directly at the edge with dramatically reduced power and cost. The secret lies in our sensor bridge and sensor switch architecture, enabling sensor-to-compute over Ethernet using GPU Direct RDMA. This delivers ultra-low latency data transfer from sensor directly into the GPU, achieving real-time AI performance like never before. This isn't just a demo, it is a glimpse into the future of edge intelligence. Come explore how Advantech and NVIDIA making the edge AI faster, leaner, and more powerful than ever, right here at Advantech.

title: From Hope to Fear: Inside the Immigration Crackdown
transcription: The pain behind the silence. The root of the unrest. This protest in America didn't erupt overnight. It was born from years of quiet suffering. For decades, millions of undocumented immigrants worked silently. They labored in the fields, cleaned homes, and powered the economy from behind the scenes. Yet, their presence was always treated as temporary, tolerated, not accepted. Then, in early 2025, the US government launched a harsh campaign called the Immigration Dragnet. Raids began in areas densely populated by undocumented workers. Farmers, builders, cleaners, and families who had lived in the country for decades. Homes were stormed, workplaces were invaded. It wasn't just a legal crackdown. It was a message. This country is not yours. That campaign lit a fuse. It started in Los Angeles. A small group of farmworkers walked out onto the streets. Their eyes full of tears, their hands holding signs, their voices trembling with one message. We are human, not illegal. Soon it spread across the country. New York, Chicago, Houston, Sacramento, city after city saw waves of peaceful protesters. They weren't just speaking for themselves. They spoke for the ones who had been detained, the parents separated from children, the silent. The response was brutal. Police fired tear gas, national guard troops were deployed. Mainstream media painted them as threats, as outsiders. But the truth was simple. They were just asking to be treated as people. Dreams, fear, and the road ahead. What now? Now the question stands, where is this going? Some politicians call it a victory for law and order. Others see it as a new face of racial injustice. But for the people on the ground, this is not just about laws. It's about homes, families, and futures. This is a battle for belonging. Experts say, if the movement stays united, if their voices don't scatter, this won't be just a protest, it will become a movement. A movement that could reshape immigration policy and redefine what the American dream truly means. Because the real question is, is the American dream only for those with papers or also for those with calloused hands?

It was also one of the places hardest hit with graffiti during the protest. Museum board member Bill Fujioka says he's dumbfounded a museum built on the spot where thousands of Japanese Americans were shipped off to internment camps would be targeted by so-called immigration supporters. What's happening now is an element has come into this peaceful protest to just cause destruction, havoc and with just madness. But amid all this graffiti and damage comes redemption. This morning, a small group of people who were part of the protests the last few days showed up this morning to help clean up the mess left behind, a mess they say they don't support. Susan Chicarol and a handful of demonstrators reached out to the museum and Little Tokyo community leaders, looking to right what they say is a wrong that came from the hands of a small group of instigators. title: What No One Tells You About Buying a VW Camper Van
transcription: There's an old saying that you can't polish a turd, and the same goes with camper vans. It's very easy to fall into the trap of buying a van with a funky paint job that looks great, but underneath, it could end up costing you a fortune. Firstly, make sure to check the service history. And secondly, it's always beneficial to get a mechanic to check the van over if you're not too sure. The best camper is the one that you'll use the most. Nobody wants to set off on their adventures with a van that might not get there. Although, at least if you do break down, you can still make a cuppa. The short wheel base, like we have here, versus the long wheel base is a debate that divides the camper community. It's nice to have the extra space inside that the long wheel base gives you, but if you're using it as your everyday car, the short wheel base is a much better everyday package. They maneuver better and they just about fit in a standard parking space, whereas the long wheel base will leave its boot hanging out, and that's never a good sight. There's a reason why the short wheel base drastically out sells the long wheel base. It's because it makes a much better everyday package. However, if you have another car and you're just using your camper for camping trips, the long wheel base may be worth a look. There's a good reason why the vast majority of camper vans have the traditional side kitchen, rear bed layout. It gives you good seating for four people if you swivel the seats like this, and a quick and easy to pull out bed with plenty of room for two people. However, although it works for the vast majority of people, there are other options for layouts depending on how you're going to use your van. You can have a rear lounge, but it does mean you get a smaller kitchen, or you can have a big long side kitchen with a bench on the other side, but that does mean you can only have the front traveling seats. But, if you do have only the two or maybe three seats in the front, it can limit how you use your van, especially if you're using it every day. There is no wrong layout. There's just the one that suits you best. But bear in mind, when it comes to moving the van on, the traditional side kitchen will be much easier to sell. Adding the ability to stand up in your van is something that most people would find essential. and this is usually done by a pop top. I always tell people the biggest difference they'll find with having a pop top is getting dressed in the morning. Unless you're a contortionist, the morning routine is something that's quite difficult to do when you can't stand up. On top of that, if you're intending to use your van on days where the sun might not be beaming, a bit like today, it's quite nice to be able to have a place to retire to and stretch your legs away from the weather. Just make sure when you're buying a roof for your vehicle, you buy a good quality one. Unfortunately, the boom in the camper van industry over the past few years has led to quite a few poor quality roofs hitting the market. With it being such a big part of your conversion, it's really not worth cutting corners here. Just make sure to go to a reputable company like ourselves who can show you that safety and quality are a high priority. No matter what your situation, a camper van is a big purchase. It's something you buy with your heart to fulfill our deep rooted desire for adventure. The last thing you need is for it to become a headache. But you need to use your head and make sure that you've got reassurances that your van has got a warranty. Don't let some backstreet cowboys ruin your dream. Make the right choices to ensure you can sleep soundly at night.

title: 🔴 IT'S OFFICIAL: BRYAN MBEUMO JOINS MANCHESTER UNITED IN €50 MILLION BLOCKBUSTER DEAL 🔴
transcription: The Red Devils have officially completed the signing of Brian Mbeumo from Brentford in a sensational 50 million dollars deal. This isn't just another signing. This is a statement. This is Manchester United, once again showing the world that they are serious about rebuilding, evolving, and returning to the summit of English and European football. For the past few seasons, Brian Mbeumo has quietly yet ferociously carved out a name for himself in the Premier League. While others basked in the spotlight, Mbeumo delivered week in and week out, consistently performing against the biggest teams and rising to every occasion. From solo runs that left defenders clutching at air, to cold, clinical finishes under pressure, Mbeumo became Brentford's beacon of belief. With every goal, every assist, every moment of magic, he drew attention. And now, he has arrived at the grandest theater in world football. A product of resilience, hard work, and hunger, Brian's journey from League 2 in France to the Premier League was never paved with luxury. It was built brick by brick with a fire that now burns brighter than ever and Manchester United have just added that fire to their furnace. Tactical intelligence meets relentless energy. What does Mbeumo bring to Manchester United? In one word, balance. In the modern game, balance is everything and few understood that better than Portuguese mastermind Ruben Amorim, who, speaking about the move, had this to say. Brian Mbeumo is not just pace and flair. He is intelligence, discipline, and purpose. He brings balance to United's attack. He offers tactical width, counter-pressing strength, and decision-making in the final third. This is not just a good signing. This is a necessary one. Whether deployed as a right winger, a second striker, or even as an inverted forward cutting inside from the left, Mbeumo offers dynamism that Manchester United desperately need. He reads space brilliantly, times his runs with surgical precision, and crucially doesn't shy away from defensive responsibilities. For a side often accused of lacking coherence in attack, his arrival represents clarity and a turning point. As the deal was finalized and the documents were signed at Carrington, the excitement among the club's inner circle was palpable. Mbeumo arrived for his medical with a calm smile, not overwhelmed, not boastful, just ready. Ready for the challenge, ready for the pressure, ready to wear the badge. Standing inside Old Trafford for the first time as a United player, he looked out at the empty stands and whispered to the staff beside him. I've imagined this moment since I was a child. This is not just another stop in his career. This is the destination he's been working towards all along. The welcome of a family, the expectation of a legacy. From the club's side, the welcome was immediate and wholehearted.

title: Premier League - Official App Review
transcription: For every passionate follower of English football, the official Premier League app promises to be your ultimate digital companion, bringing you every goal, stat, and story straight from the source. Its biggest strengths are its comprehensive and reliable real-time match data. You get instant live scores, detailed statistics, matchday live blogs, and up-to-the-minute league tables. It's also the official hub for Fantasy Premier League, FPL, allowing you to manage your team, make transfers, and track your points seamlessly within the app. You'll find a rich library of video highlights, exclusive news, detailed player profiles, and historical data, making it a true statistical treasure trove for fans. But for the honest truth, while the core content is fantastic, users frequently report technical glitches and bugs, particularly with the FPL section, which can sometimes freeze or fail to refresh properly. The app's overall stability and speed can sometimes be inconsistent, especially during peak match times. While it offers highlights, it does not provide live streaming of matches. You'll need separate TV or streaming subscriptions for that. And some features, like certain advanced FPL options, can sometimes feel better on the desktop website than in the app. So, is the Premier League official app a must have for fans? Absolutely. For real-time data, FPL management, and comprehensive news, it's an indispensable free tool. Just be prepared for the occasional app quirk that might make you yell at your phone. title: John Lennon and Paul McCartney almost had a Beatles reunion gig in 1976?
transcription: In April 1976, six years after the Beatles' official breakup, an unusual moment in television history nearly triggered a legendary reunion. Lorne Michaels, the newly appointed producer of Saturday Night Live, made a bold and humorous pitch during a live broadcast. Looking straight into the camera, he offered the Beatles $3,000 to reunite on the SNL stage and perform three of their classic songs. Holding up a check, Michaels jokingly added that the money could be split however they wished, even suggesting that if they felt Ringo Starr didn't deserve an equal share, they were free to divide the funds accordingly. The proposal was clearly meant as satire, but fatefully, two of the Beatles, John Lennon and Paul McCartney, were watching the show that very night. McCartney happened to be visiting Lennon at his Dakota apartment in New York City, only a short cab ride away from the NBC studio. According to various sources, including Tom Doyle's Man on the Run, the two icons laughed heartily at Michael's stunt. Lennon, amused, turned to McCartney and suggested, half-jokingly, "Should we go down there and just do it?" They were reportedly close to calling a cab, but ultimately decided against it, citing the late hour and their desire to relax. It was a near miss that fans have since romanticized as the Beatles reunion that almost happened. Although Lennon and McCartney didn't follow through, the moment lived on as a curious what if in pop culture. Later that year, George Harrison appeared on SNL's cold open. In a scripted bit, he confronted Lorne Michaels to claim the $3,000. Michaels explained deadpan that the offer was intended for all four members and that Harrison alone was only entitled to $750. Harrison, staying in character, haggled for an extra $250 if he agreed to say the famous line, "Live from New York, it's Saturday night." This whimsical series of events has become a cherished anecdote among Beatles fans, capturing a moment when a spontaneous, lighthearted invitation nearly brought together two of the world's most influential musicians. It stands as a testament to the Beatles' enduring presence in the public imagination and how even the most casual of gestures can ripple through music history.

title: Best Games For Apple Watch Series 10: Top 7 Cool & Fun Games!

transcription: Paris, the city of lights, the city of love, the city of secrets. Beneath the romance and elegance lies a world unseen. Let's begin where most stories do, at the top. The Eiffel Tower, rising over 300 meters above the city, wasn't always adored. When it was built in 1889, many Parisians despised it. They called it an eyesore, a disgrace to the skyline. But Gustav Eiffel saw the future, and he was right. Today, it's the beating heart of Paris. But few know what's hidden within. Inside the tower, secret rooms and military bunkers tell stories of war and resistance. Gustav Eiffel had his own private apartment at the top, a sanctuary in the sky away from the city's chaos. Now, let's descend. Paris is not just beautiful, it's layered. Beneath the cobblestone streets lies a second city, hidden passages, World War II bunkers, secret metro stations, some still in use, others abandoned and lost to time. Urban explorers whisper of the Phantom metro lines and government tunnels that link key institutions beneath the surface. And deeper still lie the catacombs. Over 6 million souls rest beneath Paris, skeletons arranged in eerie patterns, lining the walls of ancient limestone quarries. This labyrinth stretches for over 200 miles, most of it off limits, uncharted, and forbidden. But the curious always find a way. There are tales of secret cinemas, illegal parties, even entire art galleries hidden in the underworld. Some say there are chambers no one has entered in centuries. Paris reveals herself only to those who look closely. So next time you stroll by the Sen or gaze at the Eiffel Tower, ask yourself what lies beneath.

title: Paris Fire Chief emphasizes natural gas, carbon monoxide safety after 2 emergencies
transcription: One city's fire department is sharing safety reminders after a pair of natural gas and carbon monoxide emergencies in the same day. Paris fire officials say it all started when customers at a glass shop on Lakeside Terrace Drive reported smelling natural gas. Staff then checked the gas meter and found a leak. Later that day, officials say a car crashed into a home near Blackburn and Van Streets. A natural gas line was damaged there. The driver contacted Ameren and fire crews secured the area. Blackburn Street was shut down while repairs were made. Fire officials say all homes should have one of these, a carbon monoxide detector within 15 feet of every sleeping area. Gas leaks are not always noticeable by smell, making this safety precaution even more crucial.

title: Nicole Kidman Breaks Silence on Life After Divorce from Keith Urban
transcription: Nicole Kidman just broke her silence, and what she said hits deep. The Oscar-winning actress is opening up like never before, revealing the emotional truth behind her recent split from Keith Urban, and how she's finally taking control of her life's direction. In a new interview with Vogue, recorded just before filing for divorce, Nicole shared words that now sound almost prophetic. Quote, How many times do you have to be taught, she said, that you think you know where your life is going and then it isn't going in that direction. Unquote. At the time, no one knew what was coming, but just a few weeks later, the world found out that Nicole had officially filed to end her 19-year marriage to country star Keith Urban. Now, fans are reading that quote in a whole new light. Nicole wasn't just reflecting, she was preparing herself for change, for peace, and for freedom. During the interview, she talked about what it means to protect her peace and to choose herself, even when it's hard. She recalled skipping the 2024 Venice Film Festival where she was supposed to accept a best actress award following the heartbreaking loss of her mother, Janelle Kidman. Quote, Everyone was saying, you've got to still go and accept the award, she shared. And I just sat for a minute and said, no, I can't. I don't and I won't. Unquote. That moment said it all. Nicole was done living for what others expected. She was finally standing up for herself, saying no when she needed to, and yes to her own healing. It's a powerful message, especially coming from someone who's lived so much of her life in the public eye. After nearly two decades of marriage, raising two daughters, and balancing massive careers, Nicole's words remind us that even icons have to stop, breathe, and choose peace. As she steps into this new chapter, Nicole Kidman isn't just turning the page, she's rewriting the story on her own terms. title: Mystro Driver App Review: Does It Really Worth It Or Not?
transcription: Ever tried juggling Uber, Lyft, and DoorDash all at once, only to feel like you need eight arms and a crystal ball? That's exactly why I downloaded the Maestro Driver app, and after weeks of testing, here's the real story. Maestro's biggest selling point is automation. It automatically switches between Uber and Lyft based on the filters you set, like trip distance, passenger rating or surge pricing. That means no more fumbling between apps while driving, and yes, it actually makes multitasking safer. For me, it cut down the stress of choosing rides and helped me grab better paying trips without staring at my phone. The app also tracks earnings across platforms, which is huge for seeing if the grind is actually worth it. I loved opening one screen and knowing instantly what my day added up to. On the flip side, it's not perfect. The subscription fee feels steep if you're only driving part-time. And sometimes the app lags or misses a request during busy hours. Also, it currently supports only certain markets, so availability can be hit or miss. Still, for full-time gig drivers, Maestro can feel like having a digital co-pilot. If you want to maximize rides and reduce the chaos of app switching, it's worth considering. Just know you're paying for convenience, not magic.

title: How To Enable Hearing Aid Features On AirPods Pro 3 – Live Listen & Boost
transcription: AirPods Pro 3, released in September 2024, can function as over-the-counter hearing aids for mild to moderate hearing loss. First, pair them as hearing aids in iOS settings. Go to settings, accessibility, hearing devices. Select your AirPods Pro 3 and tap use as hearing aid. This activates FDA compliant amplification with adjustable settings for each ear. Two key features enhance hearing, Live listen and boost, which is integrated into adaptive audio. These features require a compatible iOS device, iPhone 12 or later, running iOS 17 or higher. Live listen turns your iPhone into a remote microphone, streaming audio directly to your AirPods Pro 3. To enable it, open control center by swiping down from the top right corner of your screen. Tap the ear icon, then toggle live listen on. Keep the iPhone near the sound source for best results. Adaptive audio dynamically adjusts amplification, boosting softer sounds such as conversations in noisy environments. To enable it, go to settings on your iPhone. Navigate to accessibility, then hearing devices. Select adaptive audio to activate the feature. These features combined make the AirPods Pro 3 a versatile solution for improving hearing in various situations.

title: Pre Premier League Era
transcription: The pre-Premier League era. Before the Premier League existed, top-flight English football was organized through the Football League, founded in 1888. For over a century, it was the undisputed pinnacle of English club football. It featured multiple divisions, a structured promotion and relegation system, and iconic rivalries. But despite the passion, the league never commanded the massive global TV revenue or corporate sponsorship deals that would come decades later. Attending a match was a community affair. Working class fans packed terraces shoulder to shoulder, singing anthems unique to their towns and waving handmade banners. Local pride, not profit, was the lifeblood of football. Facilities were basic, ticket prices were low, and players often lived modest lives, sometimes holding second jobs. But change was coming. By the late 1980s and early 1990s, English football faced existential challenges. The Heysel Stadium disaster, 1985, in which 39 people died due to crowd violence at a European Cup final, led to a ban on English clubs in European competition.

In the 20th century, Franklin D. Roosevelt led America through the Great Depression and World War II. John F. Kennedy inspired a generation with his call to ask not what your country can do for you. Each president left a mark that defined an era. Some presidencies brought scandal, like Richard Nixon's Watergate. Others, like Ronald Reagan's, reshaped American politics for decades. In 2008, Barack Obama made history as the nation's first African-American president, proving that the story of America is always evolving. Today, the presidency continues to be the most powerful office in the world, a position that reflects America's struggles, dreams, and its constant fight to live up to its ideals. title: 45,000 homes in Berlin without power after politically motivated attack by 'left-wing extremists'
transcription: Around 45,000 households were left without electricity in southwest Berlin after high-voltage power lines were damaged by a fire, which authorities have described as a politically motivated attack by far-left extremists. With power restored in some areas, around 35,000 households will remain affected until Thursday, authorities have said, as poor weather conditions continue to hamper repair operations. Police patrols were heavy and the military has set up shelters for those whose homes are already too cold to stay in. Last September, an attack on an electricity pylon in Berlin left around 50,000 homes without power, taking around 60 hours to be restored.

title: Thousands fill London streets for "Unite the Kingdom" rally
transcription: over the weekend and estimated 110,000 people took to the London streets in what's believed to be the largest anti-immigration protest in British history. The march was organized by the far right anti-immigration activist Tommy Robinson. It was billed as a celebration of free speech. And close by there was a much smaller counter protest organized by anti-racism activists. At one point, right-wing marchers clashed with the group and began throwing things at them and pushing police. title: How To Sync Apple Watch To Strava? Connect Apple Health Data To Strava App!
transcription: Want to sync your Apple Watch or Apple Health data and workouts to Strava? Well, in this video, I'll show you the step-by-step process to connect your Strava account to Apple Health. But before we start with the steps, make sure that you have both the Apple Health and the Strava app on your iPhone, and you log in to your Strava account. The first thing that you want to do is open the Apple Health app. On the Health app homepage, tap on the profile icon in the top right. Under the privacy section, you'll find the apps option. Open it and select Strava. Here you'll see two sections. Allow Strava to write and allow Strava to read. Turn on the toggles below the allow Strava to read section. This allows the Strava app to only read your Apple Health data and not overwrite it. Unless you want that, in which case you can also turn on all. Now, open the Strava app, go to the U section and tap on this gear icon. Now from this list, select manage apps and devices. Under the services section, you'll find the health app. Open it and again tap on the health app and tap on connect. Now from here, you can select what data you want to sync. Allow Strava to write will sync the data from Strava app to the Health app. Whereas allow Strava to read will sync the data from the Health app to the Strava. After making this selection, tap on allow. And now as you can see, Strava is now connected with the Health app. Here it shows a demo activity I just did before syncing. By tapping on import, I can transfer all the workout data from Apple Watch to Strava. You can import all workouts from your Apple Watch for the last 90 days to your Strava account. As soon as the import is finished, reload the activities page and you'll see your workouts on the Strava app. Here is the same activity open on my Apple Watch Series 10. And as you can see, the distance and duration is on point. The calorie burn is also accurate. Apple Watch shows my average pace is 11:53, whereas on the Strava, it shows us 11:52. And the average heart rate is a little bit off. But other than that, the sync is pretty accurate. And that's how you can link or connect your Apple Watch with Strava. If you found this video helpful, then leave a like and subscribe to your Holic for more variable videos. Thanks for watching.

title: DJI Neo 2 Is Coming: New Leak Confirms Cost and Worldwide Release Dates
transcription: The drone world has been buzzing with rumors for weeks, and now it looks like everything is lining up because the DJI Neo 2 is finally about to make its debut. According to new leaked information, DJI will officially reveal the Neo 2 on October 30th. But here's the twist: It won't be available worldwide right away. Instead, international buyers may have to wait until November 13th for units to start showing up in stores. So yes, the launch is happening soon, just not as soon as everyone hoped. Now let's talk about the part everyone cares about, price. The first DJI Neo was a budget friendly entry drone, coming in under $200. It was small, beginner friendly, and surprisingly capable. But this time, DJI seems ready to take things to the next level. Pricing leaks. Fly Solo bundle, $259 US, 229 pounds, UK, 239 euros, Europe. This is the basic version with the drone and one intelligent flight battery. Fly More combo, $429 US, 349 pounds in the UK, 399 euros in Europe. This adds more batteries, the Motion 3 controller, and an adapter for DJI Goggles. Motion Fly More combo, top tier, $599 in the US, 579 pounds in the UK, 569 euros in Europe. This is the maxed-out kit for people who want the full DJI experience right out of the box. That's about a $40 increase over earlier expectations. But it looks like DJI is giving real upgrades to match that price bump. What's new in the Neo 2? Leaks suggests the Neo 2 is getting a two-axis gimbal for smoother video, upgraded from the single axis system in the original Neo. Omnidirectional obstacle avoidance, a feature usually found in much more expensive drones. A more refined design for better handling and wind resistance. When you compare that to something like the DJI Mini 4 Pro, which sells for around $759, the Neo 2 still comes in at a much more affordable level while delivering some of the same smart features. Why this matters? The original DJI Neo was a starter drone. The Neo 2 feels more like an intro-level powerhouse, still light, still easy to carry, but now with features that appeal to vloggers, travelers, and even beginner filmmakers. If these leaks are correct, and the source behind them has a strong history of accurate DJI information, then the Neo 2 might be the most appealing travel drone of the season. title: Spain Floods | Torrential Rain Hits Valencia | News9
transcription:
Spain, torrential rain triggered severe flooding in parts of Valencia on Monday as storm Gabriel continues to batter the region. The state meteorological agency, AEMET, extended a red alert until midday, warning of more heavy downpours with, in fact, Tarragona also under the highest alert. In the Ebro Delta alone, up to 200 mm of rain fell within just 8 hours. Emergency services were deployed across Zaragoza where rescues were carried out, including children evacuated by inflatable boats. Now streets remain swamped while cleanup of mud and debris is underway after the overnight storm. Gabriel had earlier struck Portugal's Azores islands with less intense winds and rains, though damage from toppled trees and collapsed roofs was reported. The memory of last year's devastating floods which killed over 220 people in Valencia still haunts residents, many of whom blame officials for failing to issue timely warnings. The authorities are urging vigilance as the storm system threatens to dump even more rain across Eastern Spain.

title: Microsoft Announces Portable Xbox Handheld Console with ROG Partnership - Holiday Season Update
transcription: Looking for a fast charging ultra responsive stylus for your iPad? Meet the 2X fast charge active stylus pen, designed for 2018 to 2025 Apple iPads. Take your creativity and productivity to the next level. Click the link in the video description to shop now on Amazon. Welcome to Xbox Central where we're breaking down the latest news in the gaming world. Today, we've got some massive updates on Microsoft's new handheld console, and trust us, it's going to change the game. Microsoft has officially announced its first dedicated Xbox handheld device, and it's set to hit stores this holiday season. That's right, folks. The wait is almost over for gamers who have been clamoring for a portable Xbox experience. And if that wasn't exciting enough, we've just learned that this console will be a collaboration with ROG, a gaming computer brand owned by ASUS. This partnership brings us an unbeatable combination of power and portability. The AMD Ryzen Z2 chip will be the driving force behind these handheld consoles, ensuring lightning fast performance and seamless gameplay on the go. Now, we know what you're thinking, how powerful can this thing really be? Well, according to Microsoft, there are two versions of the handheld console available. The ROG Xbox Ally X and the ROG Xbox Ally. The Ally X is set to be a premium option, boasting the same AMD Ryzen Z2 chip as the Ally, but with a sleek black design that's sure to turn heads. On the other hand, we have the ROG Xbox Ally, which will offer half the power of its bigger brother, making it more budget-friendly. However, this doesn't mean you'll be sacrificing any performance, the Ryzen chip still packs quite a punch. But what really gets us excited here is the fact that these handheld consoles will allow players to access their entire game library on the go. Whether you're at home, in bed, or even on a plane, you can play Xbox games with Xbox controls paired with the power of a PC, no question about it. This is going to shake up the gaming landscape. And what's more exciting still? Microsoft has revealed that these handheld consoles will be available for both Xbox and PC games. Imagine being able to take your favorite PC game on the go or picking up a new console game at any moment. The possibilities are endless. We're just days away from the holiday season, and these new consoles are set to hit stores. Now, we know there's no release date or price revealed yet, but trust us when we say that this is something you won't want to miss out on. Xbox Central will be keeping a close eye on all things Microsoft gaming, so stay tuned for more updates and behind-the-scenes insights. That's it for today, folks. Get ready for the ultimate portable Xbox experience like never before. Until next time, see you at Xbox Central.

title: Samsung Galaxy A57 5G - OFFICIAL FIRST LOOK!
transcription: Finally, we get the first official look at the Galaxy A57 5G. Samsung is preparing to launch the device, which comes with a refreshed back design, while maintaining its modern and premium look. The smartphone features a redesigned camera module, giving it a unique identity within the mid-range lineup. After launching the Galaxy S26 series last month, Samsung is now focusing on its mid-range A series devices with the Galaxy A37 and Galaxy A57 expected to release soon. Several details about both smartphones have already surfaced, including recent leaks revealing their full color options. At Ytech B, we now have access to the official renders of both devices showcasing all available color variants. According to Roland Quant from Win Future, who shared the color details on Blue Sky, both upcoming A series phones will be available in five color options. The Galaxy A57 is expected to come in charcoal, icy blue, gray, lilac and navy. Renders of the device in these color variants are now available. The more affordable Galaxy A37 will also feature five color choices, white, charcoal, gray green, lavender and navy. From a design perspective, the Galaxy A57 has slimmer bezels compared to the A37. Both smartphones follow a similar design language, featuring buttons placed on the right side, an oval-shaped camera module at the back, and a glass back panel. A new official leak from the European Union's Iprel database, first reported by Newarmobil, reveals key details about the upcoming Samsung Galaxy A37 and Samsung Galaxy A57. Both phones have secured an A energy efficiency rating and are rated for up to 53 hours A37 and 52 hours A57 of battery life on a single charge, a major improvement over the previous generation. The listing also shows 1,200 charge cycles for battery longevity, which appears lower than last year, but is likely due to updated EU testing standards rather than a drop in quality. In terms of durability, both devices are expected to feature an IP68 rating, upgrading from IP67. This means better protection against dust and water, allowing submersion in up to 1.5 m of water for 30 minutes. The A57 also reportedly gets a higher drop resistance grade than the A37, suggesting stronger build materials. Both smartphones are expected to launch in March 2026.

title: The Paris uprising / revolution scene (1830)#edit#viral#fyp
transcription: Rumors had been spreading for weeks in Paris about a secret society plotting to overthrow the monarchy. The year was 1830, and the city was a powder keg of discontent. Citizens whispered of the Carbonari, an Italian revolutionary group advocating for liberty and national unity. Their influence had seeped across the borders, igniting hopes among the French populace. As discontent bloomed, tensions escalated. On the morning of July 28th, crowds filled the streets, demanding the abdication of King Charles I 10th. They chanted revolutionary songs inspired by the whispers of the Carbonari. Meanwhile, clandestine meetings were held in darkened cafes where members plotted strategies and informed the masses. On that fateful day, barricades sprang up across the capital. By evening, the government was in chaos and the monarchy crumbled. The uprising proclaimed the July monarchy, forever intertwining the fates of Paris and the Carbonari. Thus the whispers transformed into a cry for freedom, echoing through the annals of history.
